definition_zh: 研讨课；研讨会；专题讨论班
definition_en: a class or meeting in which a small group discusses one subject in depth
core_image: 十几个人围成一圈，桌上摊着同一份未定稿的论文，每个人轮流指出其中的漏洞
scene: 教室里桌椅被摆成一圈，导师把刚打印的草稿分给每个人，学生轮流指出论证里的漏洞。The seminar met every Thursday to argue over one draft at a time.
sceneCN: 这里本词指大学里以讨论为主的小班课程（第 1 个义项：师生围坐、靠发言与质疑推进的研讨课）；句意为这门研讨课每周四聚一次，每次只围绕一份草稿争论。

pos.zh: 研讨课；研讨会；专题讨论班（可数）

derivatives.zh: 由基础词加表「人」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「神学院在读学生」
源自同一拉丁「苗圃」词，语义偏移为「培养神职人员的学院」
由基础词加表「成员」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「神学院成员」
由基础词加表场所的名词构成，语义偏移为「研讨课教室」
由基础词加表序列的名词构成，语义偏移为「成系列的研讨活动」

senses.title: A small discussion class
senses.titleCN: 大学里以讨论为主的小班课
senses.definition: a university class in which students and a teacher discuss readings in a small group
senses.definitionCN: 大学里师生人数不多、以讨论阅读材料为主的课程
senses.example: The seminar met every Thursday to argue over one draft at a time.
senses.exampleCN: 这门研讨课每周四聚会，每次只就一份草稿展开争论。
senses.why: Seminar began as a seedbed for future scholars, so the classroom sense keeps the image of a place where ideas are raised.
senses.whyCN: 本词最初指培育未来学者的苗圃，因此课堂义仍保留「让思想生长之地」的意象。

senses.title: A scholarly conference session
senses.definition: a meeting where researchers present papers on one subject and discuss them
senses.definitionCN: 研究者就同一主题宣读论文并讨论的会议
senses.example: Three speakers at the seminar questioned the same dataset.
senses.exampleCN: 研讨会上有三位发言者对同一组数据提出质疑。
senses.why: When the seedbed moved into professional life, it named gatherings where researchers plant new work.
senses.whyCN: 苗圃这一意象进入职业生活后，就用来指研究者播下新成果的聚会。

senses.title: One session of a larger meeting
senses.titleCN: 大型会议中的分组场次
senses.definition: a single scheduled block of a conference devoted to one topic
senses.definitionCN: 大型会议中按主题划分、有固定时段的一场
senses.example: Her talk moved to the Friday morning seminar on soil science.
senses.exampleCN: 她的报告被改到周五上午的土壤科学专场。
senses.why: A large meeting is cut into small plots, and each plot keeps the name of the seedbed.
senses.whyCN: 大型会议被切成小块，每一块都沿用「苗圃」这个名字。

senses.title: A training workshop for practitioners
senses.titleCN: 面向从业者的培训研讨班
senses.definition: a short course in which professionals discuss cases and practise methods
senses.definitionCN: 职业人士在短期内讨论案例、练习方法的课程
senses.example: The hospital runs a seminar on wound care for new nurses.
senses.exampleCN: 医院为新护士开设伤口护理研讨班。
senses.why: The word spread from universities to any setting where experienced people raise beginners.
senses.whyCN: 该词从大学扩散到一切由熟手培养新手的场合。

senses.title: A historical training college
senses.definition: in the nineteenth century, a college where priests were trained
senses.definitionCN: 十九世纪训练神职人员的学院
senses.example: The old seminar building now houses the town library.
senses.exampleCN: 那座旧神学院建筑如今是市立图书馆。
senses.why: German theological schools borrowed the Latin word for a seedbed, and English took over that use.
senses.whyCN: 德国神学校借用了拉丁语里「苗圃」一词，英语又接过了这一用法。

senses.title: An in-house expert briefing
senses.definition: an internal meeting in which an expert explains a topic to staff
senses.definitionCN: 由专家向员工讲解某一主题的内部会议
senses.example: A seminar on data privacy filled the conference room.
senses.exampleCN: 一场关于数据隐私的讲座坐满了会议室。
senses.why: Firms copied the university format because a small room of listeners still produces shared knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 企业照搬大学的形式，因为一屋子的听众仍能共同形成认识。

senses.title: An online discussion event
senses.definition: a live discussion held over video with remote participants
senses.definitionCN: 通过视频连线、有远程参与者实时讨论的活动
senses.example: The seminar drew four hundred listeners from nine countries.
senses.exampleCN: 这场线上研讨会吸引了九个国家共四百名听众。
senses.why: When the room becomes a screen, the seedbed travels and keeps its name.
senses.whyCN: 当房间变成屏幕，苗圃换了地方却保留了名字。

senses.title: A masterclass with a visiting artist
senses.definition: a session in which a visiting artist discusses work with advanced students
senses.definitionCN: 来访艺术家与高年级学生讨论作品的课程
senses.example: The visiting cellist gave a seminar to six composition students.
senses.exampleCN: 来访的大提琴家为六名作曲学生开了一场大师班。
senses.why: Conservatories borrowed the academic format for the arts, where the same small circle still matters.
senses.whyCN: 音乐学院把这一学术形式借到艺术领域，小圈子照旧是关键。

intro.en: Seminar comes from Latin seminarium 'seedbed', from semen 'seed' plus the place suffix -arium; the academic sense entered English through German university practice in the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: 本词来自拉丁语「苗圃」，由表「种子」的词干加表处所的后缀构成；学术义经十九世纪德国大学制度进入英语。

items.en: Semen meant 'seed', the source of plant growth and, by image, of future people.
items.cn: 这一拉丁词意为「种子」，既是植物生长的源头，也比喻未来的人。

items.en: Seminarium added the place suffix, so it named a seedbed and later any place where the young are raised.
items.cn: 加上表处所的后缀后，该词指苗圃，后来也指培养年轻人的地方。

items.en: German universities used Seminar for a training college, especially for teachers and priests, in the late eighteenth century.
items.cn: 十八世纪末，德国大学用它指培养教师与神职人员的训练机构。

items.en: English adopted the word in the nineteenth century for a small class built on discussion rather than lecture.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪借入该词，指以讨论而非讲授为主的小班课。

items.en: In the twentieth century it spread to conferences, hospitals, firms and online platforms, each keeping the small-group core.
items.cn: 二十世纪它扩散到会议、医院、企业与网络平台，各自保留小群体这一核心。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first citation): the Indo-European root behind semen is generally considered to be a reconstruction, and the earliest academic citation is not settled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与最早书证）：种子一词背后的印欧词根一般认为是重构形式，学术义最早书证年代亦无定论。

note.en: Group one collects forms that look or sound close and are often mistaken for one another; group two collects words for meetings and teaching.
note.cn: 第一组是形近或音近、常被混用的形式；第二组是表示会议与教学的词。

entries.definition: From a Greek word for a drinking party; in English a formal meeting at which several speakers address one theme.
entries.definitionCN: 源自希腊语「饮酒聚会」，英语中指多位讲者围绕一个主题发言的正式会议。

entries.definition: A session in which people produce something together, with practice rather than papers at the centre.
entries.definitionCN: 参与者共同动手做出成果的活动，核心是实操而非论文。

entries.definition: A talk by one speaker to a large audience, the reverse of the small exchange in a seminar.
entries.definitionCN: 一位讲者面向众多听众的报告，与本词的小规模交流正好相反。

entries.definition: A teaching session with a tutor and very few students, often reviewing set work.
entries.definitionCN: 由导师带极少数学生、常用于复习指定作业的教学环节。

entries.definition: A large organised meeting lasting days; a seminar may be one session inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 持续数天的大型组织性会议；本词可以是其中的一场。

entries.definition: A setting for open public discussion, stressing exchange of views rather than teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 公开交流的场合，强调观点交换而非教学。

entries.definition: Any group taught together; the seminar is the small, discussion-heavy kind.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指一起上课的群体；本词特指人数少、以讨论为主的那一类。

entries.definition: A meeting where information is given to people who then act on it, with less open debate.
entries.definitionCN: 向参与者交代信息、随后据以行动的会议，公开辩论较少。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin semen 'seed' plus a place suffix: a seedbed where ideas are raised.
normal.cn: 拉丁语表「种子」的词干加表处所的后缀：让思想发芽的苗圃。

normal.en: The family runs seminar, seminar room, seminar series, seminar paper.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括研讨课、研讨室、系列研讨活动与研讨课论文。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: a seminar on climate policy, a graduate seminar, a seminar series.
normal.cn: 固定说法：气候政策研讨会、研究生研讨课、系列研讨活动。

normal.en: The place suffix also appears in aquarium and herbarium, both containers for living or dried specimens.
normal.cn: 同一表处所的后缀也见于水族箱与植物标本馆，二者都是存放活体或干标本之处。

normal.en: Seminar, symposium, workshop and tutorial differ in group size and in what the group produces.
normal.cn: 研讨课、专题研讨会、工作坊与辅导课在人数与产出上各不相同。

abstract.en: Picture a seedbed under glass: small, warm, and holding more future than present.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃罩下的苗圃：小而暖，装着比现在更多的未来。

abstract.en: Picture six chairs pulled into a circle while a hundred empty seats stay stacked against the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象六把椅子被拉成一圈，上百个空座位仍靠墙堆着。

abstract.en: Picture a draft page passed hand to hand until the margins fill with arrows.
abstract.cn: 想象一页草稿在人手间传递，页边逐渐写满箭头。

examples.en: She signed up for a seminar on research methods.
examples.cn: 她报名参加了一门研究方法研讨课。

examples.en: The seminar on ancient trade drew scholars from four continents.
examples.cn: 那场关于古代贸易的研讨会吸引了四大洲的学者。

examples.en: Our team joined a lunchtime seminar about data privacy.
examples.cn: 我们团队参加了一场关于数据隐私的午间讲座。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把「种子」与「地方」合起来看——育种的苗圃，引申为培育思想的研讨课。

root: 拉丁 seminarium「苗圃」＝表「种子」的词干＋表处所的后缀；经德语大学制度进入英语，指以讨论培养人才的小班；更深词源一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one model: a small enclosed plot where something is raised, moved from university classrooms to conferences, hospitals, firms, screens and studios.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个模型展开：一小块被围起来的培育之地，从大学课堂依次移到会议、医院、企业与屏幕、排练室。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small circle of chairs around one draft, with an empty lecture hall next door.
core.cn: 核心意象：一小圈椅子围着一份草稿，隔壁是空着的讲演厅。

branches.en: CLASSROOM SEEDBED: the first sense is the university plot where students raise arguments.
branches.cn: 课堂苗圃：第一个义项是大学里学生培育论点的场地。

branches.en: CONFERENCE PLOTS: a large meeting is divided into small plots, each still a seedbed.
branches.cn: 会议地块：大型会议被分成小块，每一块仍是苗圃。

branches.en: WORKPLACE PLOTS: hospitals and firms copy the format to raise beginners and brief staff.
branches.cn: 职场地块：医院与企业借用这一形式培养新人、向员工通报。

branches.en: HISTORICAL PLOT: the nineteenth-century training college is the literal seedbed for priests.
branches.cn: 历史地块：十九世纪的培养机构是神职人员的字面苗圃。

branches.en: NEW SURFACES: the seedbed travels to a screen and to a music studio without losing its small circle.
branches.cn: 新表面：苗圃移到屏幕与音乐教室，小圈子的形态没有丢。

intro.en: Seminar is a Latin noun with a place suffix; root and suffix also build a small family of English words, so the whole word can be read in parts.
intro.cn: 本词是带处所后缀的拉丁名词，词根与后缀还构成少量英语词，因此可以按部分读出整个词。

latinIntro.en: Latin semen supplies the seed idea, and the place suffix appears in many English nouns for containers and sites; the English word adds no further affix.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表「种子」的词干提供核心义，表处所的后缀出现在许多英语容器与场所名词中；英语词本身不再加缀。

items.example: The seed is the smallest unit that carries a future plant.
items.exampleCN: 种子是承载未来植株的最小单位。

items.example: A seminarium was ground prepared for sowing.
items.exampleCN: 苗圃是为播种整理好的土地。

items.example: The seminar met on Thursday.
items.exampleCN: 这门研讨课周四聚会。

items.meaning: a student at a theological college
items.example: The seminarian studied Latin for six years.
items.exampleCN: 这位神学院学生学了六年拉丁语。

items.example: The seminary moved to the hill in 1901.
items.exampleCN: 该神学院于 1901 年迁到山上。

items.example: Each seminarist kept a reading journal.
items.exampleCN: 每位神学院成员都记读书日志。

items.meaning: a room used for discussion classes
items.example: The seminar room seats fourteen.
items.exampleCN: 研讨室可坐十四人。

items.meaning: a set of linked discussion sessions
items.example: The series ran for ten weeks.
items.exampleCN: 该系列研讨活动持续十周。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 与种子有关的；适于播种的

definition_zh: 行动；作为；作用；情节；诉讼
definition_en: something done, the process of doing it, or the effect a thing produces
core_image: 一只手按下开关，灯亮起，随后整条流水线开始转动，静止的车间瞬间进入运转
scene: 会议室里的人争论了整晚，天亮时终于有人在方案末尾签字，纸面上的字变成当天就要执行的步骤。The committee's first action was to freeze the budget until the audit ended.
sceneCN: 这里本词指一个具体采取的举动（第 1 个义项：为达到目的而做的一件事）；句意为委员会的第一个举动是冻结预算，直到审计结束。

derivatives.zh: 由基础词加表「人」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「表演者、行动者」
由表「行动者」的词加表「性质或机构」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「行动能力、代理机构」
源自同一拉丁动词的复数形式，语义偏移为「待办事项清单」
由表「做」的词根加表「倾向」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「积极的、起作用的」
由表「使成为」的前缀加基础词构成，语义偏移为「使成为法律、颁布」

senses.title: One deed performed
senses.definition: a single thing that someone does, especially one chosen on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 某人有意识地做出的单件事
senses.example: The committee's first action was to freeze the budget until the audit ended.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会的第一个举动是冻结预算，直到审计结束。
senses.why: Action comes from a Latin verb meaning 'to do, drive', so the noun names one completed doing.
senses.whyCN: 本词出自表「做、驱使」的拉丁动词，因此名词指一件已完成的行为。

senses.title: The process of doing
senses.definition: the process of doing something rather than only talking or planning
senses.definitionCN: 真正动手去做，而非只谈或只计划
senses.example: The report calls for action, not another round of studies.
senses.exampleCN: 报告呼吁动手去做，而不是再做一轮研究。
senses.why: The same noun can name the doing itself, not only one finished deed.
senses.whyCN: 同一名词也能指「做」这件事本身，而不只是某件已完成的事。

senses.title: Effect produced by a thing
senses.definition: the way a substance, machine or force produces an effect
senses.definitionCN: 物质、机械或力产生效果的方式
senses.example: The action of the drug begins within twenty minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 药效在二十分钟内开始。
senses.why: If doing is the core, then a thing that does something also has action.
senses.whyCN: 既然「做」是核心，那么会起作用的东西也拥有「作用」。

senses.title: Events in a story or play
senses.definition: the sequence of events that moves a story, film or play forward
senses.definitionCN: 推动故事、影片或戏剧向前的一连串事件
senses.example: Most of the action happens in the last ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分情节发生在最后十分钟。
senses.why: A story is a chain of doings, so its events are called action.
senses.whyCN: 故事本是一串行为，因此其中的事件被称为情节。

senses.title: Fighting in war
senses.definition: fighting between armed forces, or a single engagement
senses.definitionCN: 武装力量之间的交战或一次交火
senses.example: He was wounded in action near the river.
senses.exampleCN: 他在河畔的战斗中负伤。
senses.why: The most forceful kind of doing gave the word its military sense.
senses.whyCN: 最猛烈的一种「做」赋予了该词军事义。

senses.title: A legal case
senses.definition: a case brought to a court for judgment
senses.definitionCN: 提交法院请求裁断的案件
senses.example: The landlord brought an action against the tenant.
senses.exampleCN: 房东对房客提起了诉讼。
senses.why: A lawsuit is a formal doing carried out in court, and the word kept that legal reading.
senses.whyCN: 诉讼是在法庭上进行的一种正式行为，该词保留了这一法律读法。

senses.title: An official measure
senses.definition: an official step taken to deal with a problem
senses.definitionCN: 为处理某问题而采取的官方步骤
senses.example: The city took action against illegal dumping.
senses.exampleCN: 市政府对非法倾倒采取了措施。
senses.why: Public bodies do things through decided steps, and each step borrows the plain noun.
senses.whyCN: 公共机构通过确定的步骤做事，每一步都借用这个普通名词。

senses.title: Movement of the body
senses.definition: a movement or gesture of the body, especially in dance or sport
senses.definitionCN: 身体的动作或姿态，尤指舞蹈或运动中
senses.example: The coach slowed the action down to show the footwork.
senses.exampleCN: 教练放慢动作以展示步法。
senses.why: A body that acts makes visible movements, so the noun also names those movements.
senses.whyCN: 会行动的身体产生可见的动作，名词也就指这些动作。

senses.title: Live filming rather than animation
senses.definition: filming with real people and places instead of drawn or generated images
senses.definitionCN: 用真人实景拍摄，而非绘制或生成的影像
senses.example: The chase was shot in live action with no digital doubles.
senses.exampleCN: 追逐场面以实拍完成，没有数字替身。
senses.why: Real performers doing the deed gave film-making the phrase for what is not drawn.
senses.whyCN: 真人演员亲自去做，影视业便用这个词指非绘制部分。

intro.en: Action comes from Latin actio 'a doing', from the verb agere 'to do, drive, lead'; the same verb supplies several English words about doing.
intro.cn: 本词来自拉丁语 actio「行为」，出自动词 agere「做、驱使、引领」；同一动词还构成若干与「做」有关的英语词。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, lead, set in motion'; the driving image explains why the noun covers both a deed and a working effect.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱使、引领、使动」，其中「驱使」的意象解释了该名词为何兼指行为与作用。

items.en: Actio was the noun of result: a doing, a performance, a legal proceeding.
items.cn: actio 是表结果的动名词：一次行为、一场表演、一桩法律程序。

items.en: Old French action brought the word into English, where it first named legal and military doings.
items.cn: 古法语把该词带入英语，最初多指法律与军事上的行为。

items.en: By the sixteenth century the word covered the events of a play or poem, since a plot is a chain of doings.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，该词已覆盖戏剧与诗歌中的事件，因为情节本就是一串行为。

items.en: Physical and chemical writing adopted action for the working of a force or substance, as in the action of a drug.
items.cn: 物理与化学写作采用该词指力或物质的作用，如药物的作用。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind agere is generally considered to be a reconstruction; the first legal citation in English is not dated with certainty.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：agere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式；该词在英语中最早的法律书证年代并无定论。

note.en: Group one holds short and long forms of the same Latin verb, easily confused in grammar; group two holds English words for a thing done.
note.cn: 第一组是同一拉丁动词的短长形式，在语法上容易混用；第二组是英语中表示「做过的事」的词。

entries.definition: The short noun for one thing done, often a formal or performed deed, as in an act of Parliament.
entries.definitionCN: 同样源自拉丁语、形式更短的名词，常指正式或表演性的行为，如议会法案。

entries.definition: A noun for doings spread over time; action is one deed, activity is the stream of them.
entries.definitionCN: 表持续状态的名词，指一段时间里展开的活动；本词指单个举动，它指一连串举动。

entries.definition: The person who performs an action, on stage or in a process; it adds the suffix for a person.
entries.definitionCN: 行为的执行者，舞台上或过程中的行动者；加了表人的后缀。

entries.definition: From Latin exigere 'to drive out, weigh precisely', built on the same driving verb but with another prefix; it means precise, not performed.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁语「驱出、精确称量」，虽用同一「驱使」动词却带另一前缀；意为精确，与行为无关。

entries.definition: An old English word for something done, often judged good or bad; action is neutral and wider.
entries.definitionCN: 英语本族词，指做过的事，常带好坏评价；本词中性且范围更广。

entries.definition: One move in a planned sequence; an action may stand alone.
entries.definitionCN: 计划序列中的一步；本词可以是单独举动。

entries.definition: A decided official step to solve a problem; it is a subset of actions.
entries.definitionCN: 为解决某问题而定的官方举措，是本词所指行为的一类。

entries.definition: The working of a system, or a surgical act; it stresses process or procedure.
entries.definitionCN: 系统的运转或外科手术；强调过程与程序。

entries.definition: A step in a game, negotiation or plan, chosen with an opponent in mind.
entries.definitionCN: 游戏、谈判或计划中顾及对手而选的一步。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin agere 'to do, drive': one deed is one push of the driving verb.
normal.cn: 拉丁语表「做、驱使」：一件行为就是这一动词的一次推动。

normal.en: The family runs act, action, active, actor, agent, agenda.
normal.cn: 同族词包括行为、行动、积极的、行动者、代理人、议事日程。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the legal and military senses: bring an action, killed in action.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出法律与军事义：提起诉讼、阵亡。

normal.en: Chemistry says the action of a drug; film says live action.
normal.cn: 化学说药物的作用，影视说真人实拍。

normal.en: The countable word names one deed; the word with the state suffix names the uncountable stream.
normal.cn: 可数的形式指一件事，带状态后缀的形式指不可数的持续活动。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on a switch and a whole factory floor starting to turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按下开关，整个车间开始转动。

abstract.en: Picture a row of dominoes: one push, then a hundred falls that nobody touched.
abstract.cn: 想象一排多米诺骨牌：一次推动，随后上百张倒下，无人再碰。

abstract.en: Picture a courtroom where the only thing moving is a single sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭里唯一在动的东西是一页纸。

examples.en: The action of the acid on the metal was slower than expected.
examples.cn: 酸对金属的作用比预期慢。

examples.en: Her first action after the meeting was to call the supplier.
examples.cn: 会后她做的第一件事是给供应商打电话。

examples.en: The film mixes live action with painted backgrounds.
examples.cn: 这部电影把真人实拍与手绘背景混在一起。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「做」加表结果的名词后缀——做出来的那件事就是行动；再记「一种作用、一段情节、一桩诉讼」三层。

root: 拉丁 actio「行为」出自动词 agere「做、驱使、引领」；同一动词还构成行为、行动者、议事日程等词；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one push: a single deed, the doing itself, the effect a thing produces, the chain of deeds in a story, armed doings, a court case, an official step, a body's movement and the filming of real movement.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一次推动展开：单件行为、做的过程、事物产生的作用、故事中的行为链、武装行动、法庭诉讼、官方举措、身体动作，以及记录真实动作的实拍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand pressing a switch, after which a whole line of machines begins to move.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手按下开关，随后一整排机器开始运动。

branches.en: A SINGLE DEED: the plain countable sense, one step chosen and finished.
branches.cn: 单件行为：最朴素的可数义，一个被选定并完成的事。

branches.en: DOING AND EFFECT: the process of doing and the effect a substance or force produces are two sides of the same push.
branches.cn: 做与作用：做的过程与物质或力产生的作用，是同一次推动的两面。

branches.en: PERFORMED DOINGS: a plot is a chain of deeds, and live filming records real bodies doing them.
branches.cn: 被表演的行为：情节是一串行为，实拍记录真实身体去做这些行为。

branches.en: FORMAL DOINGS: war and law turn deeds into named engagements and cases.
branches.cn: 正式行为：战争与法律把行为变成有名目的交战与案件。

branches.en: MEASURED AND VISIBLE: official measures and bodily movements are deeds made countable, by policy or by camera.
branches.cn: 可计与可见：官方举措与身体动作是被政策或镜头计数的行为。

intro.en: Action is a Latin noun of result; its root and suffix also build act, actor, agent and agenda, so the family can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 本词是表结果的拉丁名词，词根与后缀还构成行为、行动者、代理人与议事日程等词，可按语素读出整个词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere gives the verbal idea and the result suffix makes it a noun; the same suffix appears in many English nouns of action, such as the words for inspection and division.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表「做」的动词提供动作义，表结果的后缀使其成为名词；同一后缀见于许多英语动作名词，如表示「检查」「划分」的词。

items.example: The verb supplies the doing at the heart of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这一动词提供词的核心「做」。

items.example: The noun first named both deeds and court cases.
items.exampleCN: 这一名词最初兼指行为与法庭案件。

items.meaning: a deed or the doing of something
items.example: The plan moved from talk to action.
items.exampleCN: 方案从谈论转入行动。

items.example: They acted on the report at once.
items.exampleCN: 他们立即按报告行动。

items.example: The actor learned the blocking in one day.
items.exampleCN: 那位演员一天就学会了走位。

items.meaning: doing things rather than receiving them
items.example: The active member organised the vote.
items.exampleCN: 那位积极成员组织了投票。

items.meaning: the power to act, or a body that acts
items.example: The agency acted before the deadline.
items.exampleCN: 该机构在截止前采取了行动。

items.structure: agenda (Latin neuter plural, 'things to be done')
items.meaning: a list of things to do
items.example: The agenda listed six items.
items.exampleCN: 日程列出六项。

items.example: Parliament enacted the rule in May.
items.exampleCN: 议会于五月颁布该规则。

derivatives.zh: 由基础词加表「人」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「表演者、行动者」
由表「行动者」的词加表「性质或机构」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「代理机构」
由表「做」的词根加表「倾向」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「积极的」
由表「使成为」的前缀加基础词构成，语义偏移为「使成为法律」
源自同一拉丁动词的复数形式，语义偏移为「待办事项清单」

definition_en: the state of being busy doing things, or a particular thing that people do
core_image: 操场上的脚步、书架间翻动的纸页与键盘的敲击同时进行，整个场地没有一刻静止
scene: 放学后的操场上一半人在跑步，一半人在搬运展板，走廊里还有人在排练合唱。The centre offers one physical activity for every age group.
sceneCN: 这里本词指一项有组织的具体活动（第 1 个义项：为某目的而进行的一项活动）；句意为该中心为每个年龄段提供一项体育活动。

pos.zh: 活动量；忙碌状态（不可数）
活性；活度（科学技术用语）

derivatives.zh: 由表「做」的词根加表「倾向」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「积极的、运转的」
由形容词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「积极地」
由同一拉丁词根的短形式构成，语义偏移为「做出行动」
由同一词根加表结果的后缀构成，语义偏移为「单个行为」
由表否定的前缀加形容词构成，语义偏移为「不活跃的」

senses.title: One organised thing people do
senses.definition: a particular thing that people do, often for a purpose or for pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 人们为某目的或为消遣而做的一项具体事情
senses.example: The centre offers one physical activity for every age group.
senses.exampleCN: 该中心为每个年龄段提供一项体育活动。
senses.why: The noun adds the state suffix to the word for doing, so one instance of doings is an activity.
senses.whyCN: 该名词由表「做」的词加表状态的后缀构成，因此一项具体所做之事就是一项活动。

senses.title: Busy doings in general
senses.definition: the state of being busy with many small doings
senses.definitionCN: 忙于许多细小事务的状态
senses.example: The office was full of activity before the inspection.
senses.exampleCN: 检查之前办公室里一片忙碌。
senses.why: The same state suffix can name busyness itself, not only one item.
senses.whyCN: 同一状态后缀也能指忙碌本身，而不只是某一项。

senses.title: A person's usual pursuits
senses.definition: the things a person regularly does, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 一个人日常反复做的事情之总和
senses.example: Walking is her only outdoor activity now.
senses.exampleCN: 散步如今是她唯一的户外活动。
senses.why: Counting a person's doings together turns the word into a private set.
senses.whyCN: 把一个人的所做之事合起来计数，该词就成了私人的一套安排。

senses.title: School or club programmes
senses.definition: organised pursuits offered by a school or club outside lessons
senses.definitionCN: 学校或社团在课程之外组织的活动
senses.example: The school added two after-school activities this term.
senses.exampleCN: 学校这学期新增了两项课后活动。
senses.why: Institutions group their doings into named slots, and each slot is an activity.
senses.whyCN: 机构把所办之事分成有名目的时段，每个时段就是一项活动。

senses.title: Biological or chemical working
senses.definition: the measurable working of an enzyme, hormone or substance
senses.definitionCN: 酶、激素或物质可测量的作用强度
senses.example: The enzyme's activity drops sharply above forty degrees.
senses.exampleCN: 温度超过四十度后，这种酶的活性急剧下降。
senses.why: A substance that does something has measurable activity, a technical narrowing of busyness.
senses.whyCN: 会起作用的物质具有可测量的活性，这是「忙碌」在技术上的收窄。

senses.title: Economic business volume
senses.definition: the level of buying, selling and producing in a market
senses.definitionCN: 市场上买卖与生产的活跃程度
senses.example: Building activity slowed after the interest rate rose.
senses.exampleCN: 利率上升后，建筑活动放缓。
senses.why: Markets are counted by how much doing goes on, so volume became activity.
senses.whyCN: 市场按「做了多少」来计数，于是成交量就成了活动量。

senses.title: Geological or volcanic working
senses.definition: the movement of magma, faults or tremors in the earth
senses.definitionCN: 岩浆、断层或震动的运动
senses.example: Volcanic activity has increased since March.
senses.exampleCN: 自三月以来火山活动增多。
senses.why: The earth is treated as a body that does things, and its doings are activity.
senses.whyCN: 地球被当作会「做事」的物体，它的所作所为就是地质活动。

senses.title: Intensity of a radioactive source
senses.definition: the number of nuclear decays per unit time in a source
senses.definitionCN: 放射源单位时间内发生核衰变的次数
senses.example: The sample's activity fell to half within eight days.
senses.exampleCN: 该样品的活度在八天内降到一半。
senses.why: Physics measures how much a source does in a unit of time and calls that its activity.
senses.whyCN: 物理测量一个源在单位时间内「做」了多少，并称之为活度。

intro.en: Activity comes from Medieval Latin activitas, from activus 'active', itself from agere 'to do'; it entered English through French in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: 本词来自中世纪拉丁语 activitas，出自 activus「积极的」，再上溯动词 agere「做」；十六世纪经法语进入英语。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, set in motion', the source of the whole family.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱使、使动」，是整个词族的源头。

items.en: Activus meant 'doing, effective', an adjective built from the same root with a suffix of tendency.
items.cn: activus 意为「在做的、有效的」，由同一词根加表倾向的后缀构成的形容词。

items.en: The abstract noun activitas named the state of being at work, adding a suffix of state to the adjective.
items.cn: 抽象名词 activitas 指「处于运作中的状态」，在形容词后加了表状态的后缀。

items.en: French brought the word into English in the sixteenth century, first as a word for active power or energy.
items.cn: 法语在十六世纪把该词带入英语，最初指积极的力量或能量。

items.en: The nineteenth and twentieth centuries made the word countable, so schools, economists and physicists could count activities one by one.
items.cn: 十九与二十世纪使该词可数，学校、经济学家与物理学家因此能一项一项地计数。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind agere is generally considered to be a reconstruction, and the earliest English citation is not fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：agere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式；该词最早英语书证年代并无定论。

note.en: Group one holds forms built on the same doing root; group two holds English words for how time is spent.
note.cn: 第一组是同一「做」词根构成的形式；第二组是英语中表示时间如何花掉的词。

entries.definition: The countable word for a single deed; activity covers doings spread over time.
entries.definitionCN: 可数形式指单件行为；本词覆盖一段时间里展开的活动。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning doing things or working; it describes, while the noun names the doings.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「在做事的、运转的」的形容词；它作描述，本词作名称。

entries.definition: A person who performs, formed with the suffix for an agent, not with a state suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 由表施事者的后缀构成，指表演或行动的人，而非状态名词。

entries.definition: The short verb and noun at the base of the family; it names a deed without the state suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 词族基部的短动词与名词，只指行为，不带状态后缀。

entries.definition: An interest or occupation pursued regularly, often with effort and purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 长期投入精力去做的兴趣或事务，常带目的性。

entries.definition: Something done for enjoyment, with no useful purpose claimed.
entries.definitionCN: 只为消遣而做的事，不强调实际用途。

entries.definition: Planned bodily movement for health; it is one kind of physical activity.
entries.definitionCN: 为健康而安排的身体运动，是体育活动的一种。

entries.definition: A task or project one has agreed to carry out, usually large and formal.
entries.definitionCN: 已承诺执行的较重要、较正式的任务或项目。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The word is the state form of the doing root, so it names doings as an ongoing condition.
normal.cn: 该词是「做」这个词根的状态形式，因此把各种所做之事当作持续状态来命名。

normal.en: The family runs act, action, active, actively, activity, inactive.
normal.cn: 同族词包括行为、行动、积极的、积极地、活动、不活跃的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: physical activity, economic activity, volcanic activity.
normal.cn: 固定说法：体育活动、经济活动、火山活动。

normal.en: Schools count activities; laboratories measure activity in units.
normal.cn: 学校数活动项目，实验室用单位测量活性。

normal.en: The countable plural often means a programme of events: outdoor activities, classroom activities.
normal.cn: 可数复数常指一整套安排好的项目：户外活动、课堂活动。

abstract.en: Picture a playground where running, lifting and singing all happen at the same second.
abstract.cn: 想象一个操场，跑步、搬运与歌唱在同一秒里同时发生。

abstract.en: Picture a meter needle that never rests because something is always being done.
abstract.cn: 想象一根永不停歇的仪表指针，因为总有事情在做。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar with every square filled by a small drawing of a body in motion.
abstract.cn: 想象一本日历，每个格子都被一个运动中的身体小图填满。

examples.en: Regular physical activity lowers the risk of heart disease.
examples.cn: 规律的身体活动能降低心脏病风险。

examples.en: The town's main economic activity is fishing.
examples.cn: 这个镇的主要经济活动是捕鱼。

examples.en: Lab reports must record the enzyme activity at each temperature.
examples.cn: 实验报告须记录每个温度下的酶活性。

dict_mnemonic.text: 由「做」这个词根加表状态的名词后缀构成——正在做、反复做的那一团事情，就是活动。

root: 中世纪拉丁 activitas，出自 activus「积极的」，再上溯 agere「做、驱使」；词根加表状态的后缀使动作成为可持续的状态；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow a single state: doing goes on, and the same word counts one item, a person's routine, a school programme, a market's volume, an enzyme's working, the earth's movement and a source's decays.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种状态展开：事情持续在做，同一个词既数单项，也指个人日常、学校安排、市场成交量、酶的运作、地球的运动与放射源的衰变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many bodies and instruments all moving at once in one enclosed yard.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多身体与器械在同一块场地里同时运动。

branches.en: ONE ITEM: the countable unit is any named thing a group does.
branches.cn: 单项：可数单位是群体所做的任一有名目之事。

branches.en: ONGOING AND PERSONAL: busyness as a state and a person's regular doings are the same stream seen at two scales.
branches.cn: 持续与个人：作为状态的忙碌与个人固定的所做之事，是同一股流在两个尺度上的样子。

branches.en: ORGANISED PROGRAMME: institutions cut the stream into scheduled slots.
branches.cn: 有组织的安排：机构把这股流切成排定的时段。

branches.en: MEASURED WORKING: enzymes and radioactive sources are rated by how much they do per unit time.
branches.cn: 可测的作用：酶与放射源按单位时间内做多少来评级。

branches.en: COUNTED VOLUME: markets and the earth are also read as bodies whose doings can be counted.
branches.cn: 可计的规模：市场与地球同样被当作其所作所为可被计数的物体。

intro.en: Activity is an abstract noun built from the doing root plus a state suffix; the same parts appear across the whole family, so the word can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 本词由表「做」的词根加表状态的名词后缀构成；同样的部分贯穿整个词族，因此可按语素读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere supplies the root, and the state suffix -itas appears in many English abstract nouns such as the words for quality and security.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表「做」的动词提供词根，表状态的后缀见于许多英语抽象名词，如表示「性质」「安全」的词。

items.example: The root carries the doing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载「做」的意思。

items.example: The adjective described a working force.
items.exampleCN: 这一形容词描述正在起作用的力量。

items.meaning: the state of being at work
items.example: The abstract noun named busyness itself.

senses.title: Busy doing things
senses.definition: doing things regularly, especially physical or social things
senses.definitionCN: 经常做事，尤指体力或社交方面的事情
senses.example: She has been an active member of the rescue team since 2019.
senses.exampleCN: 她自 2019 年起就是救援队的活跃成员。
senses.why: The adjective adds a suffix of tendency to the doing root, so it describes someone inclined to act.
senses.whyCN: 该形容词由表「做」的词根加表倾向的后缀构成，因此描述倾向于行动的人。

senses.title: Taking part willingly
senses.definition: taking part in something willingly rather than watching
senses.definitionCN: 自愿参与其中，而非旁观
senses.example: Voters played an active role in the budget debate.
senses.exampleCN: 选民在预算辩论中发挥了积极作用。
senses.why: A person who acts rather than watches is active in the social sense.
senses.whyCN: 做事而非旁观的人，在社会意义上就是积极的。

senses.title: Producing an effect
senses.definition: producing a real effect, as a chemical or a force
senses.definitionCN: 产生实际效果，如化学物或力
senses.example: The active ingredient is a mild acid.
senses.exampleCN: 有效成分是一种弱酸。
senses.why: If a thing acts on something else, it is active in the technical sense.
senses.whyCN: 一个东西若作用于他物，在技术意义上就是起作用的。

senses.title: Working in a living body
senses.definition: functioning in a living organism, as a gene, enzyme or cell
senses.definitionCN: 在活体内发挥功能，如基因、酶或细胞
senses.example: Only active cells take up the dye.
senses.exampleCN: 只有活性细胞会吸收这种染料。
senses.why: Life is treated as doing, so what functions in a body is called active.
senses.whyCN: 生命被当作一种「做」，因此在体内发挥功能的就称为有活性的。

senses.title: Erupting or moving geologically
senses.definition: currently erupting, moving or likely to do so
senses.definitionCN: 当前正在喷发、移动或可能如此的
senses.example: The observatory watches three active faults.
senses.exampleCN: 观测站监测三条活动断层。
senses.why: The earth acting is a volcano or fault in motion, so the adjective marks present activity.
senses.whyCN: 地球在「做」就是火山或断层在动，因此该形容词标示当下的活动。

senses.title: On current duty or in use
senses.definition: currently serving or currently in operation
senses.definitionCN: 正在服役或在运转的
senses.example: He returned to active duty after treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 治疗结束后他回到现役。
senses.why: Something switched on and serving is acting now, not merely existing.
senses.whyCN: 已开启并正在服役的东西是「当下在做」，而不只是存在。

senses.title: The grammatical voice of the doer
senses.definition: the verb form in which the subject performs the action
senses.definitionCN: 主语执行动作的动词形式
senses.example: Rewrite the sentence in the active voice.
senses.exampleCN: 把这个句子改成主动语态。
senses.why: Grammar names the form where the subject does the deed by the same doing word.
senses.whyCN: 语法用同一个「做」词来命名主语执行动作的形式。

senses.title: Trading or moving briskly
senses.definition: busy with buying and selling, or moving in large numbers
senses.definitionCN: 买卖繁忙或数量流动很大的
senses.example: The market was active before the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 假日前市场交易活跃。
senses.why: A market that keeps doing business is called active, as a body that keeps moving.
senses.whyCN: 持续有交易的市场被称为活跃，就像一个持续活动的身体。

senses.title: Learning by doing
senses.definition: involving the learner in doing rather than only listening
senses.definitionCN: 让学习者动手参与而非只听
senses.example: The course uses active learning instead of long lectures.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课采用主动学习，而非长篇讲授。
senses.why: An active learner acts, so the adjective shifts from the person to the method.
senses.whyCN: 主动的学习者会动手，该形容词便从人移到了方法上。

intro.en: Active comes from Latin activus 'doing, effective', from actus, the past participle of agere 'to do, drive'.
intro.cn: 本词来自拉丁语 activus「在做的、有效的」，出自 agere「做、驱使」的过去分词形式。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, set in motion'; its participle actus described what has been done or set going.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱使、使动」；其分词形式描述已被做出或已被启动的东西。

items.en: Activus added a suffix of tendency to the participle stem, giving 'inclined to act, effective'.
items.cn: 在分词词干后加表倾向的后缀，构成意为「倾向于行动、有效的」形容词。

items.en: Medieval writers paired active with passive to mark what acts versus what is acted upon.
items.cn: 中世纪作者把「主动的」与「被动的」配对，用来区分施动与受动。

items.en: English took the word through French in the fourteenth century, first in philosophy and then in everyday description.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪经法语借入该词，先用于哲学，再进入日常描述。

items.en: Chemistry, grammar, geology and finance each narrowed the word to a kind of working: an ingredient, a voice, a fault, a market.
items.cn: 化学、语法、地质与金融各自把该词收窄为一种运作：有效成分、语态、断层、市场。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind agere is generally considered to be a reconstruction, not an attested form.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：agere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式，而非已见形式。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same doing root and easily swapped; group two holds adjectives for busyness and for being acted on.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「做」词根、容易互换的词；第二组是表示忙碌与受动的形容词。

entries.definition: The noun for doings; the adjective describes a person or thing that acts.
entries.definitionCN: 表活动的名词；本词是形容词，描述会行动的人或物。

entries.definition: The adverb saying how something is done; it modifies a verb rather than a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 表方式的副词，修饰动词而非名词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to set something to work, formed with the suffix meaning 'make'.
entries.definitionCN: 由表「使成为」的后缀构成的动词，意为使某物开始运作。

entries.definition: A person who performs; it names the doer with a suffix for a person, while the adjective names the tendency.
entries.definitionCN: 指表演或行动的人，用表人的后缀；本词则以形容词后缀表倾向。

entries.definition: The common adjective for having much to do; active can also mean working in a technical sense.
entries.definitionCN: 日常常用词，指有很多事要做；本词还可指技术意义上的「在起作用」。

entries.definition: Describing plentiful physical energy and drive, a narrower kind of being active.
entries.definitionCN: 形容体力与干劲充沛，是「活跃」中较窄的一种。

entries.definition: Receiving action without initiating it, the grammatical and general opposite of active.
entries.definitionCN: 接受动作而不发起动作，是本词在语法与一般意义上的反义。

entries.definition: Describing equipment or a system that is working or fit to work; it stresses function, not initiative.
entries.definitionCN: 形容设备或系统正在运转或可运转，强调功能而非主动性。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the tendency form of the doing root: inclined to act.
normal.cn: 该形容词是「做」这个词根的倾向形式：倾向于行动。

normal.en: The family runs act, action, active, actively, activity, activate, activist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括行为、行动、积极的、积极地、活动、激活、活动人士。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: active ingredient, active volcano, active duty, active voice.
normal.cn: 固定说法：有效成分、活火山、现役、主动语态。

normal.en: Every technical sense narrows acting to a field: chemistry, geology, the military, grammar.
normal.cn: 每个技术义都把「起作用」收窄到一个领域：化学、地质、军队、语法。

normal.en: The pair active and passive marks who acts and who receives in grammar and in philosophy.
normal.cn: 「主动」与「被动」这对词在语法与哲学中标出谁施动、谁受动。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that moves before the instruction arrives.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在指令到达之前就先动了。

abstract.en: Picture a switch already flipped while the room is still dark.
abstract.cn: 想象房间还黑着，开关却已经被按下。

abstract.en: Picture a river that keeps cutting its bed instead of waiting for the flood.
abstract.cn: 想象一条不断切蚀河床的河，而非等着洪水来改道。

examples.en: She takes an active part in village affairs.
examples.cn: 她积极参与村里的事务。

examples.en: The volcano has been active for three months.
examples.cn: 这座火山已活动了三个月。

examples.en: Put the sentence into the active voice.
examples.cn: 把这个句子改成主动语态。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「做」这个词根加表倾向的形容词后缀——倾向于去做的，就是积极的、起作用的。

root: 拉丁 activus「在做的、有效的」，出自 agere「做、驱使」的过去分词词干，加表倾向的后缀；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one inclination: a person acts, a participant acts, an ingredient acts, a cell acts, a volcano acts, a soldier acts, a subject acts, a market acts and a learner acts.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿同一种倾向展开：人去做、参与者去做、成分起作用、细胞起作用、火山活动、军人服役、主语施动、市场活跃、学习者动手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand moving before any instruction arrives, while a machine beside it is already running.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手在指令到达前先动，旁边的机器已经在运转。

branches.en: PERSONAL DOING: a person who acts and a person who joins in are the same inclination seen alone and in company.
branches.cn: 个人之做：独自行动的人与参与其中的人，是同一种倾向的单独与合群两面。

branches.en: MATERIAL DOING: an ingredient and a living cell both act on something else.
branches.cn: 物质之做：有效成分与活细胞都作用于他物。

branches.en: MOTION WITHOUT A PERSON: a volcano and a market move on their own scale, and the adjective follows them.
branches.cn: 无人称的运动：火山与市场按各自尺度运动，形容词随之延伸。

branches.en: SERVICE: a soldier on duty is acting in an institution's name.
branches.cn: 服役：在役军人是以机构名义行动。

branches.en: GRAMMAR AND METHOD: a subject that acts and a learner who acts borrow the same word for who initiates.
branches.cn: 语法与方法：施动的主语与动手的学习者，都借同一个词表示「谁发起」。

intro.en: Active is an adjective built from the doing root plus a suffix of tendency; the same two parts reappear across a large family, so the word can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 本词由表「做」的词根加表倾向的后缀构成；同样的两部分在整个词族中反复出现，因此可按语素读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere supplies the root and the participle stem; the suffix of tendency also appears in English adjectives such as the words for effective and creative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表「做」的动词提供词根与分词词干；表倾向的后缀也见于英语形容词，如表示「有效」「有创造力」的词。

definition_zh: 积极地；主动地；活跃地；实时地

core_image: 一个人不坐着等通知，而是站起来走到前面，把手举起来要求发言
scene: 讨论陷入僵局时，后排一名年轻人站起来走到台前，举手要求发言并提出替代方案。She has actively campaigned for cleaner air since the factory opened.
sceneCN: 这里本词指主动而持续地投入（第 1 个义项：以主动参与的方式）；句意为自工厂开工以来，她一直在为更清洁的空气积极奔走。

senses.title: Taking part by choice
senses.definition: in a deliberate way that shows one has chosen to take part
senses.definitionCN: 以明确选择参与的方式
senses.example: She has actively campaigned for cleaner air since the factory opened.
senses.exampleCN: 自工厂开工以来，她一直在为更清洁的空气积极奔走。
senses.why: The adverb keeps the adjective's suffix of tendency and adds a suffix of manner, so it describes acting by choice.
senses.whyCN: 该副词保留形容词表倾向的后缀，又加表方式的后缀，因此描述「出于选择而行动」。

senses.title: With frequent, energetic action
senses.definition: with frequent and noticeable action over time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间里频繁而明显地行动
senses.example: The two species actively compete for the same nesting sites.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个物种一直在激烈争夺同一批筑巢地。
senses.why: Repeated doings make the adverb mean not one act but a sustained campaign.
senses.whyCN: 反复的行动使该副词不只指一次，而指持续的争夺。

senses.title: Definitely, not merely in name
senses.definition: in a way that does something definite rather than only claiming it
senses.definitionCN: 真正做出明确举动，而非只在名义上如此
senses.example: The board actively blocked the merger for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会实实在在地阻挠了那桩合并两年之久。
senses.why: A claim can be empty, but an act cannot; the adverb marks the difference.
senses.whyCN: 主张可以是空的，行动却不能，该副词正是标出这一区别。

senses.title: Continuously, in real time
senses.definition: of a device or system, working all the time rather than at intervals
senses.definitionCN: 指设备或系统持续工作而非间歇工作
senses.example: Sensors actively monitor the pressure every second.
senses.exampleCN: 传感器每秒都在实时监测压力。
senses.why: A machine that keeps acting without pause takes the adverb's sense of uninterrupted doing.
senses.whyCN: 不停动作的机器承接了该副词「不间断地做」的意思。

senses.title: While still serving
senses.definition: while holding a post or serving in the armed forces
senses.definitionCN: 在担任职务或在役期间
senses.example: He remained actively employed until December.
senses.exampleCN: 他一直实际在岗，直到十二月。
senses.why: Service is a continuing kind of acting, so the adverb marks doing while in post.
senses.whyCN: 服役是一种持续的行动，因此该副词标示「在岗期间实际在做」。

senses.title: With force to promote something
senses.definition: with visible force in support of a cause or product
senses.definitionCN: 以明显力度支持某主张或事物
senses.example: The ministry actively promotes rural clinics.
senses.exampleCN: 该部门大力推广乡村诊所。
senses.why: Promoting is doing in public, so the adverb adds force to the doing.
senses.whyCN: 推广是公开地做，该副词给这一行动加上力度。

senses.title: With visible physical energy
senses.definition: with lively bodily movement
senses.definitionCN: 以活泼的身体动作
senses.example: The children played actively until dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们一直玩到天黑，十分有活力。
senses.why: The oldest sense of acting is bodily movement, and the adverb can still point there.
senses.whyCN: 「做」最古老的意思就是身体动作，该副词仍可指回这里。

senses.title: Busily, at full operation
senses.definition: of a workplace or market, working at full load
senses.definitionCN: 指工作场所或市场满负荷运作
senses.example: The port is actively loading three ships at once.
senses.exampleCN: 港口正同时忙碌地装载三条船。
senses.why: A place that keeps doing business is described as acting without rest.
senses.whyCN: 持续有业务的地方被描述为不停地在做。

intro.en: Actively is the adverb of active, which comes from Latin activus 'doing, effective', from agere 'to do'; the manner suffix -ly is native English.
intro.cn: 本词是 active 的副词形式；active 来自拉丁语 activus「在做的、有效的」，再上溯 agere「做」；表方式的后缀是英语本族成分。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, set in motion', the source of the whole family.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱使、使动」，是整个词族的源头。

items.en: Activus 'doing, effective' added a suffix of tendency to the participle stem.
items.cn: activus 意为「在做的、有效的」，在分词词干后加了表倾向的后缀。

items.en: English borrowed active through French and used it for what acts rather than what is acted upon.
items.cn: 英语经法语借入该形容词，用来指施动者而非受动者。

items.en: The manner suffix added to the adjective produced the adverb, first recorded in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 在形容词后加英语本族的方式后缀构成副词，最早见于十五世纪。

items.en: Monitoring, employment and marketing widened the adverb from personal effort to systems that never pause.
items.cn: 监测、就业与营销等用法把该副词从个人努力扩展到永不停歇的系统。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind agere is generally considered to be a reconstruction, and the first adverb citation is not exact.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：agere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式；该副词最早书证年代并不精确。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same doing family that are easily confused in form; group two holds adverbs of effort and manner.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「做」词族、形式易混的词；第二组是表示用力与方式的副词。

entries.definition: The adjective describing a person or thing that acts; it cannot modify a verb by itself.
entries.definitionCN: 描述会行动的人或物的形容词，本身不能修饰动词。

entries.definition: The noun for doings or busyness, not a way of doing.
entries.definitionCN: 表活动或忙碌状态的名词，不表示做事的方式。

entries.definition: The noun for a single deed or the doing process; it names, while the adverb tells how.
entries.definitionCN: 指单件行为或行动过程的名词；它作名称，本词说明方式。

entries.definition: The short base form; the adverb is built on the longer adjective from the same root.
entries.definitionCN: 短小的基形式；本词由同一词根的长形容词加缀而来。

entries.definition: With abundant bodily energy; it stresses vigour rather than willingness.
entries.definitionCN: 以充沛体力进行，强调劲头而非意愿。

entries.definition: In a state of handling many things; it stresses load rather than choice.
entries.definitionCN: 处于同时处理许多事的状态，强调负荷而非选择。

entries.definition: With clear intention; it marks planning, where the actively word marks participation.
entries.definitionCN: 带明确意图，标出计划性；本词标出参与。

entries.definition: With strong force or energy, often in defence or attack.
entries.definitionCN: 以强力或劲头进行，常用于防守或攻击。

entries.definition: In a favourable or constructive manner; it is about attitude, not effort.
entries.definitionCN: 以赞同或建设性的态度，关乎态度而非投入。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adverb is the adjective of tendency plus the native manner suffix.
normal.cn: 该副词由表倾向的形容词加英语本族的方式后缀构成。

normal.en: The family runs act, action, active, actively, activity, activate, activist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括行为、行动、积极的、积极地、活动、激活、活动人士。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: actively participate, actively involved, actively monitor.
normal.cn: 固定说法：积极参与、积极投入、实时监测。

normal.en: The pair active and passive marks who acts and who receives.
normal.cn: 「主动」与「被动」这对词标出谁施动、谁受动。

normal.en: An adverb answers how; this one answers how with the added idea of choosing to do.
normal.cn: 副词回答「怎样」，这个词回答「怎样」时还带上「选择去做」的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised before the chair has finished asking.
abstract.cn: 想象主持人还没问完，一只手已经举了起来。

abstract.en: Picture a pump that never switches itself off.
abstract.cn: 想象一台从不自行关闭的泵。

abstract.en: Picture a walkway worn into grass because feet kept choosing it.
abstract.cn: 想象一条被反复选择踩出、嵌进草地里的小径。

examples.en: Local residents actively monitor the river's colour.
examples.cn: 当地居民一直在实时观察河水颜色。

examples.en: The company actively recruits graduates from inland provinces.
examples.cn: 该公司积极从内陆省份招聘毕业生。

examples.en: She was actively involved in drafting the new rules.
examples.cn: 她积极投入新规则的起草。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「积极的」加表方式的副词后缀——以主动去做的方式，就是积极地、实时地。

root: 英语 active 加本族方式副词后缀；active 出自拉丁 activus「在做的、有效的」，再上溯 agere「做、驱使」；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one manner: a person takes part, a species competes, a board refuses, a sensor watches, a worker serves, a ministry promotes, a child plays and a port loads, all by doing rather than waiting.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种方式展开：人参与、物种争夺、董事会阻挠、传感器监视、员工在岗、部门推广、孩子玩耍、港口装载，都是「做」而非「等」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand raised before the chair has finished asking, while others keep their hands down.
core.cn: 核心意象：主持人还没问完，一只手已举起，其他人仍把手放下。

branches.en: CHOSEN AND REPEATED: willingness repeated becomes a visible campaign.
branches.cn: 选择与重复：意愿反复出现，就成了看得见的持续行动。

branches.en: WITH FORCE: a refusal and a promotion are both definite acts done in public.
branches.cn: 带力度：拒绝与推广都是公开做出的明确举动。

branches.en: SYSTEMS AT WORK: sensors and ports act without pause, which is doing at full load.
branches.cn: 系统在运转：传感器与港口不停动作，即满负荷地做。

branches.en: IN POST: serving is continuing to act in an institution's name.
branches.cn: 在岗：服役是以机构名义持续行动。

branches.en: BODILY ENERGY: the oldest kind of acting is a body in lively motion.
branches.cn: 身体劲头：最古老的行动就是身体活泼地运动。

intro.en: Actively is an adjective plus a native manner suffix; the adjective itself is a Latin participle stem plus a suffix of tendency, so the word reads in three parts.
intro.cn: 本词是形容词加英语本族方式后缀；形容词本身又是拉丁分词词干加表倾向的后缀，因此整个词可分三部分读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere supplies the root and activus the adjective; the native manner suffix has no Latin source and simply marks how something is done.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表「做」的动词提供词根，表「在做、有效」的形容词提供词形；英语本族的方式后缀没有拉丁来源，只标示「以何种方式」。

items.example: The root carries the doing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载「做」的意思。

items.example: The adjective described a working force.
items.exampleCN: 这一形容词描述正在起作用的力量。

items.example: She is an active member.
items.exampleCN: 她是积极的成员。

items.example: She actively campaigned.
items.exampleCN: 她积极奔走。

items.example: The hall was full of activity.
items.exampleCN: 大厅里一片忙碌。

items.example: Press the key to activate the pump.
items.exampleCN: 按键启动水泵。

items.example: The activist spoke first.
items.exampleCN: 那位活动人士先发言。

items.example: The account sat inactively for a year.
items.exampleCN: 该账户闲置了一年。

items.example: The overactive gland caused tremors.
items.exampleCN: 过度活跃的腺体引起手抖。

derivatives.zh: 去掉表方式的副词后缀后得到形容词，语义为「积极的」
由形容词加表状态的名词后缀构成，语义偏移为「活动、活动量」
由形容词加表「使成为」的动词后缀构成，语义偏移为「使启动」
由形容词加表「人」的后缀构成，语义偏移为「为某主张奔走的人」
由表否定的前缀加本词构成，语义偏移为「不活跃地、被动地」

definition_zh: 习惯；习性；癖好；法衣；（古）体质
definition_en: a behaviour repeated so often that it becomes automatic
core_image: 同一条小路被脚步一次次踩出痕迹，最后草不再生长，只剩一条固定的路径
scene: 每天清晨同一个人沿同一条田埂走到井边，几年下来草被踩平，那条路再也看不出是走出来的。Reading before sleep had become a habit he no longer noticed.
sceneCN: 这里本词指反复到近乎自动的个人习惯（第 1 个义项：因长期重复而形成、几乎不需意志的行为模式）；句意为睡前阅读已成了他不再察觉的习惯。

derivatives.zh: 由基础词加表「具有……性质」的形容词后缀构成，语义偏移为「已成习惯的」
由形容词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「习惯性地」
由基础词加表「使成为」的动词后缀构成，语义偏移为「使习惯、使适应」
由动词加表动作或结果的后缀构成，语义偏移为「习惯化、适应过程」
源自同一拉丁动词的另一派生形式，语义偏移为「栖息地」
由表「在内」的前缀加同一拉丁动词构成，语义偏移为「居住于」

senses.title: A repeated personal behaviour
senses.definition: a way of behaving that has been repeated until it feels automatic
senses.definitionCN: 反复到几乎自动的行为方式
senses.example: Reading before sleep had become a habit he no longer noticed.
senses.exampleCN: 睡前阅读已成了他不再察觉的习惯。
senses.why: Habit comes from a Latin word for a held condition, so it names a behaviour that has taken hold of a person.
senses.whyCN: 本词来自拉丁语中表「被持有的状态」的词，因此指已经「拿住」一个人的行为。

senses.title: An addiction or compulsion
senses.definition: a strong repeated need, especially for a drug
senses.definitionCN: 强烈而反复的需要，尤指对药物
senses.example: The clinic treats people with a drug habit.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所治疗有吸毒成瘾的人。
senses.why: A behaviour repeated until it is hard to stop slides into the sense of a compulsion.
senses.whyCN: 某种行为反复到难以停止，就滑向「被迫性的瘾」这一义。

senses.title: Behaviour typical of a species
senses.definition: the usual behaviour of an animal or plant species
senses.definitionCN: 某一动植物物种常见的活动方式
senses.example: The birds' feeding habits change with the tide.
senses.exampleCN: 这些鸟的觅食习性随潮水变化。
senses.why: What a species repeatedly does is also called its habit, by the same logic as a person's.
senses.whyCN: 一个物种反复做的事也叫习性，逻辑与人的习惯相同。

senses.title: A plant's growth form
senses.definition: the characteristic shape and way a plant grows
senses.definitionCN: 植物特有的形态与生长方式
senses.example: The shrub has a low, spreading habit.
senses.exampleCN: 这种灌木呈低矮匍匐的形态。
senses.why: Botany extends the word from behaviour to the shape a plant reliably takes.
senses.whyCN: 植物学把该词从行为扩展到植物稳定呈现的形态。

senses.title: A monastic garment
senses.definition: the distinctive dress worn by a member of a religious order
senses.definitionCN: 修会成员所穿的特定服装
senses.example: She took the habit after two years of study.
senses.exampleCN: 学习两年后她穿上了修会法衣。
senses.why: Medieval Latin used the word for dress, since a garment is what one habitually wears.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语用该词指衣着，因为衣服正是人习惯性穿戴之物。

senses.title: An old word for bodily condition
senses.definition: in early medicine, the settled condition of a body
senses.definitionCN: 早期医学中指身体稳定的状态
senses.example: Physicians spoke of a phlegmatic habit of body.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时医生会谈及黏液质的体质。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a held condition, and early medicine applied it to the body's settled state.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是「被持有的状态」，早期医学用它指身体的稳定状况。

senses.title: A settled way of thinking
senses.definition: a fixed mental tendency that shapes how one judges
senses.definitionCN: 影响判断的固定心理倾向
senses.example: Optimism was a habit of mind in that family.
senses.exampleCN: 乐观在那个家庭是一种思维习惯。
senses.why: Thinking repeatedly in one way takes hold just as action does, so the word covers mind too.
senses.whyCN: 思维反复走同一条路也会「拿住」人，因此该词也覆盖心智。

senses.title: The settled practice of a group
senses.definition: a customary way of doing things inside an institution
senses.definitionCN: 某一机构内部沿袭的做法
senses.example: Silence at meetings was the habit of the house.
senses.exampleCN: 开会时不作声是那个机构的惯例。
senses.why: A group that repeats a practice turns it into a house habit, not a personal one.
senses.whyCN: 群体反复的做法把行为变成「机构习惯」，而不再是个人的。

intro.en: Habit comes from Latin habitus 'condition, bearing, dress', from habere 'to have, hold'; it entered English through Old French in the thirteenth century.
intro.cn: 本词来自拉丁语 habitus「状态、举止、衣着」，出自 habere「拥有、持有」；十三世纪经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Habere meant 'to have, hold, keep'; anything held could be described by its participle.
items.cn: habere 意为「拥有、持有、保持」，凡被持有之物都可用其分词描述。

items.en: Habitus named a condition, bearing or disposition that something or someone held.
items.cn: habitus 指某物或某人保持的状态、举止或倾向。

items.en: Medieval philosophy used habitus to render the Greek word for a settled disposition, which fixed the modern sense.
items.cn: 中世纪哲学用 habitus 翻译希腊语中表示稳定倾向的词，这奠定了现代义。

items.en: Monastic writers also used the word for the dress of an order, since clothing is what one habitually wears.
items.cn: 修会作者也用该词指修会服装，因为衣服正是习惯性穿戴之物。

items.en: English extended the word to repeated personal behaviour, and later to the behaviour of animals and plants.
items.cn: 英语把该词扩展到个人反复的行为，后来又扩展到动植物的行为。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind habere is generally considered to be a reconstruction, and the first English date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：habere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式；该词进入英语的最早年代只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words that look close and share the holding root but differ in sense; group two holds words for repeated practice.
note.cn: 第一组是形近、共用「持有」词根但意义不同的词；第二组是表示反复做法的词。

entries.definition: From the same holding root through a verb meaning to dwell; it names where a species lives, not what it does.
entries.definitionCN: 同出「持有」词根，经表「居住」的动词而来；指物种居住之处，而非其行为。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning done by habit; it describes, while the noun names the pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「已成习惯的」形容词，作描述；本词是名词，指模式本身。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to make someone used to something, adding a suffix meaning 'make'.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「使习惯、使适应」的动词，加了表「使成为」的后缀。

entries.definition: Built with a prefix meaning 'in' plus the holding verb, so it means to live in a place, not to repeat a behaviour.
entries.definitionCN: 由表「在内」的前缀加「持有」动词构成，意为居住于某地，而非重复某行为。

entries.definition: A usual way of behaving in a society or group, handed down rather than personal.
entries.definitionCN: 社会或群体中沿袭的惯常做法，多为传承而非个人形成。

entries.definition: Repeated activity done to gain skill; a habit needs no effort after it is formed.
entries.definitionCN: 为获得技能而反复从事的活动；习惯一旦形成便不费力。

entries.definition: A set order of daily tasks; a habit is one behaviour, a routine is a schedule of them.
entries.definitionCN: 日常事务的固定顺序；习惯是单个行为，日常流程是一串安排。

entries.definition: A medically defined dependence that is hard to stop, stronger than a mere habit.
entries.definitionCN: 医学上界定、难以戒断的依赖，比一般习惯更强。

entries.definition: An inclination to behave in a certain way, which may not yet be repeated enough to be a habit.
entries.definitionCN: 以某种方式行事的内在倾向，尚未反复到成为习惯。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Latin root means to have or hold: a habit is a behaviour that has taken hold.
normal.cn: 拉丁词根意为「拥有、持有」：习惯就是一种「拿住了人」的行为。

normal.en: The family runs habit, habitual, habitually, habituate, habituation.
normal.cn: 同族词包括习惯、惯常的、习惯性地、使习惯、习惯化。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: form a habit, break a habit, eating habits, out of habit.
normal.cn: 固定说法：养成习惯、改掉习惯、饮食习惯、出于习惯。

normal.en: The same root gives habitat and inhabit, which are about dwelling rather than repeating.
normal.cn: 同一词根还给出栖息地与居住，都与「住在哪里」有关，而非重复行为。

normal.en: Monastic dress is also a habit because it is what one wears every day.
normal.cn: 修会服装在英语里也用同一个词表示，因为那是每天习惯性穿戴之物。

abstract.en: Picture a path worn into grass until the soil shows through.
abstract.cn: 想象一条被踩进草地、露出泥土的小径。

abstract.en: Picture a coat hung on the same hook so long that the hook is bent.
abstract.cn: 想象一件外套长期挂在同一个钩上，钩子都被压弯。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching for the light switch before the brain has asked.
abstract.cn: 想象手在大脑发令前就伸向电灯开关。

examples.en: Making a habit of stretching takes about three weeks.
examples.cn: 养成拉伸的习惯大约需要三周。

examples.en: The island's birds have unusual nesting habits.
examples.cn: 这座岛上的鸟有罕见的筑巢习性。

examples.en: He answered from habit, without checking the date.
examples.cn: 他出于习惯作答，没有核对日期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 词根义为「持有」——某种做法长期把人「拿住」，就成了习惯；再记「习性、法衣、体质」三个扩展义。

root: 拉丁 habitus「状态、举止、衣着」出自 habere「拥有、持有」；由「被持有的状态」引申为反复成习的行为、动植物习性、习惯穿着的法衣；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one grip: a behaviour takes hold of a person, then of a species, then of a plant's shape, then of a garment worn daily, then of a body's condition, then of a mind and finally of a whole institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次「抓握」展开：一种行为先拿住一个人，再拿住一个物种、一株植物的形态、每日穿着的衣服、身体的状况、一颗心，最后拿住整个机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a path pressed into grass by the same pair of feet until the soil shows through.
core.cn: 核心意象：同双脚步把一条小路踩进草地，直到露出泥土。

branches.en: A BEHAVIOUR TAKES HOLD: the core sense is repetition that has become automatic.
branches.cn: 行为拿住人：核心义是反复到自动化的行为。

branches.en: HARD TO STOP: repetition that grips too tightly becomes compulsion.
branches.cn: 难以停止：抓得过紧的重复就成瘾。

branches.en: NON-HUMAN PATTERNS: a species and a plant both show a settled way of doing.
branches.cn: 非人的模式：物种与植物都呈现固定的做法或形态。

branches.en: WORN DRESS: a garment worn every day is literally what is held on the body.
branches.cn: 每日之衣：每日穿着的衣服字面上就是「挂在身上之物」。

branches.en: HELD CONDITIONS: the body, the mind and an institution each settle into a condition that holds.
branches.cn: 被持有的状态：身体、心智与机构都稳定成一种「被保持」的状态。

intro.en: Habit is a Latin noun of condition, and its root also builds verbs and adjectives about holding and dwelling, so the family can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 本词是表状态的拉丁名词，其词根还构成本身与「持有、居住」有关的动词和形容词，因此可按语素读出词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin habere gives the root, and several English words descend from its different stems; the noun itself adds no English affix.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表「持有」的动词提供词根，若干英语词出自它的不同词干；本词作为名词在英语中不再加缀。

items.example: The verb supplies the idea of something held.
items.exampleCN: 这一动词提供「某物被持有」的意思。

items.example: The noun named what a person or thing held.
items.exampleCN: 这一名词指人或物所保持的状态。

items.meaning: a repeated behaviour or settled condition
items.example: Reading became a habit.
items.exampleCN: 阅读成了习惯。

items.example: The habitual riser beat the alarm.
items.exampleCN: 惯于早起的人比闹钟起得早。

items.example: He habitually checks the locks.
items.exampleCN: 他习惯性地检查门锁。

items.example: Keepers habituate the animals to noise.
items.exampleCN: 饲养员让动物习惯噪声。

items.meaning: the process of becoming used to something

items.meaning: the place where a species lives
items.example: The wetland is their only habitat.
items.exampleCN: 这片湿地是它们唯一的栖息地。

items.example: Few birds inhabit the cliff.
items.exampleCN: 很少有鸟住在崖上。

definition_zh: 惯常的；已成习惯的；惯犯的；语法惯常体的
definition_en: done regularly because of habit, or describing a person who does something regularly
core_image: 门卫不看钟就打开侧门，因为身体已经记住了那个时刻，动作先于念头
scene: 门卫每天在同一时刻打开侧门，从不抬头看钟，因为身体已经记住了那个时间点。The habitual early riser had finished two chapters before the household woke.
sceneCN: 这里本词指长期形成、几乎自动的（第 1 个义项：因习惯而反复发生的）；句意为这位惯于早起的人在家人都醒来前已读完两章。

senses.title: Done by habit
senses.definition: repeated so often that it is done automatically
senses.definitionCN: 反复到自动进行的
senses.example: The habitual early riser had finished two chapters before the household woke.
senses.exampleCN: 这位惯于早起的人在家人都醒来前已读完两章。
senses.why: The adjective is the noun of habit plus a suffix meaning 'of that kind', so it describes what belongs to a habit.
senses.whyCN: 该形容词由「习惯」这一名词加表「属于该类」的后缀构成，因此描述由习惯而来的行为。

senses.title: Of a person who regularly does something
senses.definition: describing a person who does something as a settled pattern
senses.definitionCN: 描述把某事做成固定模式的人
senses.example: The habitual walker knew every bend of the road.
senses.exampleCN: 这位惯常走路的人熟悉这条路的每个弯。
senses.why: The suffix can describe the person as well as the act, since a habit belongs to its bearer.
senses.whyCN: 该后缀既能描述行为，也能描述人，因为习惯属于其持有者。

senses.title: Of a repeat offender in law
senses.definition: in law, describing someone repeatedly convicted of the same offence
senses.definitionCN: 法律上描述屡次因同类罪行被定罪的人
senses.example: The court treated him as a habitual offender.
senses.exampleCN: 法院把他视为惯犯。
senses.why: Law takes repeated behaviour and gives it a formal name with the same adjective.
senses.whyCN: 法律接过「反复行为」，用同一形容词给了它正式名称。

senses.title: Of a regular customer or visitor
senses.definition: describing someone who comes to a place as a matter of course
senses.definitionCN: 描述照例常来某处的人
senses.example: The cafe saves a seat for its habitual guests.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆为老主顾留一个座位。
senses.why: A repeated visit is a habit too, so shops apply the word to regulars.
senses.whyCN: 反复光顾也是一种习惯，店家便用它指常客。

senses.title: Of repeated drug use
senses.definition: describing use that has become a compulsion
senses.definitionCN: 描述已变成强迫性依赖的使用
senses.example: Habitual use of the drug damages the liver.
senses.exampleCN: 习惯性使用该药物会损害肝脏。
senses.why: The medical sense keeps the idea of repetition but adds the grip of compulsion.
senses.whyCN: 医学义保留「反复」，又加上强迫性抓握的含义。

senses.title: Of a species' fixed behaviour
senses.definition: describing behaviour that a species reliably shows
senses.definitionCN: 描述某物种稳定呈现的行为
senses.example: Habitual nest building begins before the rains.
senses.exampleCN: 固有的筑巢行为在雨季前开始。
senses.why: Ethology borrows the adjective for patterns fixed across a species.
senses.whyCN: 动物行为学借用该形容词指整个物种固定的行为模式。

senses.title: Done from routine, without thought
senses.definition: done because it is the usual course, with little attention
senses.definitionCN: 因循惯例、不加留意的
senses.example: A habitual nod was his only reply.
senses.exampleCN: 一个机械的点头就是他唯一的回应。
senses.why: Repetition without attention is the dark side of habit, and the adjective carries it.
senses.whyCN: 不加留意的重复是习惯的另一面，该形容词也带上这层意思。

senses.title: Of the grammatical aspect for repeated events
senses.definition: in grammar, marking an action that is repeated as a rule
senses.definitionCN: 语法中标记按规律反复发生的动作
senses.example: Some languages mark habitual aspect with a separate suffix.
senses.exampleCN: 有些语言用单独的后缀标记惯常体。
senses.why: Grammar names the form that presents an action as customary, borrowing the adjective directly.
senses.whyCN: 语法用这个形容词直接命名把动作呈现为惯例的形式。

intro.en: Habitual is habit plus the Latin-derived adjective suffix -ual, from Latin habitualis, itself from habitus 'condition'; the root is habere 'to hold'.
intro.cn: 本词由 habit 加源自拉丁语的形容词后缀构成，拉丁语形式出自 habitus「状态」，词根为 habere「持有」。

items.en: Habere 'to have, hold' supplied the root for a family of words about holding and condition.
items.cn: habere「拥有、持有」为一批表「持有与状态」的词提供了词根。

items.en: Habitus named a settled condition or bearing, the base of the English noun.
items.cn: habitus 指稳定的状态或举止，是英语名词的基础。

items.en: Habitualis added an adjective suffix meaning 'of the kind of', so it described what belongs to a condition.
items.cn: 加上表「属于该类」的形容词后缀后，它描述属于某种状态的东西。

items.en: The adjective reached English through French in the medieval period, applied first to states of body and mind.
items.cn: 该形容词在中世纪经法语进入英语，最初用于身体与心智的状态。

items.en: Law used it for repeat offenders, and grammar for repeated events, each narrowing the same idea of the customary.
items.cn: 法律用它指惯犯，语法用它指反复事件，各自把「惯例性」收窄。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind habere is generally considered to be a reconstruction; the earliest English use is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：habere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式；最早英语用例年代并不精确。

note.en: Group one holds close forms from the same holding root; group two holds adjectives for what is usual and repeated.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「持有」词根的形近形式；第二组是表示「通常、反复」的形容词。

entries.definition: The noun naming the repeated pattern; it is what the adjective qualifies.
entries.definitionCN: 指那种反复模式的名词，正是本词所修饰的对象。

entries.definition: The adverb saying that something is done by habit; it answers how, not which.
entries.definitionCN: 表「出于习惯地」的副词，回答「怎样」而非「哪一个」。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to accustom someone, formed with a suffix meaning 'make'.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「使某人习惯」的动词，由表「使成为」的后缀构成。

entries.definition: From the same root through a dwelling verb; it names a living place, not a repeated act.
entries.definitionCN: 同根词经表居住的动词而来，指生活场所，而非反复行为。

entries.definition: Fixed by the usage of a community rather than by one person's repetition.
entries.definitionCN: 由群体习俗确定，而非由个人反复形成。

entries.definition: Describing someone who has become used to a condition, with less stress on the act itself.
entries.definitionCN: 描述已习惯某种状况的人，对行为本身的强调较弱。

entries.definition: Happening at even intervals; habitual stresses the grip of repetition, not the timetable.
entries.definitionCN: 按均匀间隔发生；本词强调反复的黏着，而非时间表。

entries.definition: Describing a condition or behaviour lasting a long time, often with harmful effect.
entries.definitionCN: 描述持续很久的状况或行为，常带害处。

entries.definition: Describing a habit or attitude fixed by long use, stronger and more literary than habitual.
entries.definitionCN: 描述因长期沿袭而固定的习惯或态度，比本词更强、更书面。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the habit noun plus a suffix meaning 'of that kind'.
normal.cn: 该形容词由「习惯」名词加表「属于该类」的后缀构成。

normal.en: The family runs habit, habitual, habitually, habituate, habituation.
normal.cn: 同族词包括习惯、惯常的、习惯性地、使习惯、习惯化。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: habitual offender, habitual smoker, habitual behaviour.
normal.cn: 固定说法：惯犯、惯常吸烟者、惯常行为。

normal.en: Law and grammar each borrow the adjective for their own kind of repetition.
normal.cn: 法律与语法各自借用该形容词来指自己领域的反复。

normal.en: The root family also gives habitat and inhabit, which are about place rather than repetition.
normal.cn: 同根词族还给出栖息地与居住，关乎地点而非反复。

abstract.en: Picture a hand finding the gate latch in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在黑暗里摸到门闩。

abstract.en: Picture a road with two ruts so deep that wheels no longer choose.
abstract.cn: 想象一条车辙深到车轮不再需要选择的路。

abstract.en: Picture a clock that runs a minute fast, and every schedule quietly follows it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只快一分钟的钟，所有日程都悄悄跟着它走。

examples.en: Habitual lateness cost him the job.
examples.cn: 惯常迟到让他丢了工作。

examples.en: The study tracked habitual readers over ten years.
examples.cn: 这项研究跟踪了有阅读习惯的人十年。

examples.en: A habitual offender faces a longer sentence.
examples.cn: 惯犯面临更长的刑期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「习惯」加表「属于该类」的形容词后缀——属于习惯的那一类，就是惯常的、已成习惯的。

root: 拉丁 habitualis，出自 habitus「状态、举止」，词根为 habere「拥有、持有」；形容词后缀表「属于该类」，因此指属于某种反复状态的；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one adjective: what belongs to a repeated pattern describes an act that runs itself, a person who runs it, an offender in law, a regular guest, a compulsion, a species, a mechanical nod and a grammatical aspect.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个形容词展开：凡属于反复模式者，可描述自行运转的行为、其人、法律上的惯犯、常客、依赖、物种、机械的点头与语法体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gateman opening the side door at the same minute without looking at the clock.
core.cn: 核心意象：门卫在同一分钟打开侧门，却不抬头看钟。

branches.en: OF THE ACT: the plain sense describes an act that repeats itself.
branches.cn: 属于行为：最普通的义项描述自行重复的行为。

branches.en: OF THE PERSON: the habit belongs to the one who carries it.
branches.cn: 属于其人：习惯属于持有它的人。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONAL LABELS: law names repeat offenders, commerce names regular guests.
branches.cn: 机构标签：法律点名惯犯，商业点名常客。

branches.en: TIGHTENED AND THINNED: compulsion is repetition with a grip, mechanical routine is repetition without attention.
branches.cn: 收紧与变薄：成瘾是带抓握的重复，机械例行是不带留意的重复。

branches.en: FIXED FORMS: a species and a grammatical aspect both fix repetition into a rule.
branches.cn: 固定形式：物种与语法体都把反复固定为规则。

intro.en: Habitual is a noun of condition plus an adjective suffix, and the same two parts reappear in many English adjectives, so the word can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 本词是表状态的名词加形容词后缀，同样的两部分见于许多英语形容词，因此可按语素读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin habere supplies the root through habitus, and the adjective suffix meaning 'of the kind of' also appears in English words such as the one for annual.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表「持有」的动词经其状态名词提供词根，表「属于该类」的形容词后缀也见于英语中表示「每年的」等词。

items.example: The root carries the idea of something held.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载「被持有」的意思。

items.example: The noun named a settled condition.
items.exampleCN: 这一名词指稳定的状态。

items.example: Reading became a habit.
items.exampleCN: 阅读成了习惯。

items.example: The habitual riser beat the alarm.
items.exampleCN: 惯于早起的人比闹钟起得早。

items.example: He habitually checks the locks.
items.exampleCN: 他习惯性地检查门锁。

items.example: Keepers habituate animals to noise.
items.exampleCN: 饲养员让动物习惯噪声。

items.example: Habituation took four weeks.
items.exampleCN: 适应花了四周。

items.example: The syrup is habit-forming.
items.exampleCN: 这种糖浆容易使人成瘾。

items.example: The habitualness of the gesture went unnoticed.
items.exampleCN: 这个动作的惯常性无人注意。

definition_zh: 习惯性地；一贯地；经常地
definition_en: in a way that is done regularly because it has become a habit
core_image: 散会时同一个人总把椅子推回桌下，即便当天他不是最后走的人
scene: 每次散会前，同一个人总会把椅子推回桌下，即使那天他不是最后离开的人。He habitually checks the locks twice before leaving, even in daylight.
sceneCN: 这里本词指出于长期习惯而反复做（第 1 个义项：以习惯性的方式）；句意为他在离开前习惯性地检查两遍门锁，即使是在白天。
