senses.title: Liking one thing more
senses.definition: a stronger liking for one thing than for another
senses.definitionCN: 对某物的喜欢超过对另一物的喜欢
senses.example: Her preference is for strong tea rather than coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 她偏爱浓茶而非咖啡。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to carry a thing in front; what is put in front is what one favours.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为把某物搬到前面；被放到前面，就是被偏爱的。

senses.title: The right to be served first
senses.definition: the right or practice of being dealt with before others
senses.definitionCN: 先于他人得到办理或照顾的权利或做法
senses.example: Give your preference to families with small children when seats are limited.
senses.exampleCN: 座位有限时优先安排带幼儿的家庭。
senses.why: Being placed before others is a literal carrying forward, so the noun marks rank as well as taste.
senses.whyCN: 被放在他人之前，正是字面意义上的搬到前面，因此该名词也标出次序。

senses.title: A trade advantage
senses.definition: a lower tariff or easier terms granted to certain trading partners
senses.definitionCN: 给予某些贸易伙伴的较低关税或更宽条件
senses.example: The agreement grants tariff preference to the smallest exporters.
senses.exampleCN: 该协议给予最小规模的出口商关税优惠。
senses.why: A partner carried to the front of the queue is a partner who pays less at the border.
senses.whyCN: 被提到队伍前面的伙伴，就是在关境上付款更少的伙伴。

senses.title: A first claim in law
senses.definition: the right of one creditor to be paid before others from a debtor's property
senses.definitionCN: 某一债权人从债务人财产中先于他人受偿的权利
senses.example: The bank's preference over the land was recorded at the registry.
senses.exampleCN: 银行对这块地的优先受偿权已在登记处记录。
senses.why: Law keeps the order of payment literal: one claim is carried ahead of the rest.
senses.whyCN: 法律把付款次序说得很字面：一项债权被搬到其余债权之前。

senses.title: One's first choice
senses.definition: the person or thing one would choose first if only one could be had
senses.definitionCN: 若只能得到一个，会最先选择的人或物
senses.example: This route is our preference for the crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路线是我们过河的首选。
senses.why: Choosing is ranking, and the top of the ranking is what stands in front.
senses.whyCN: 选择就是排序，排在最前面的那一个就是被放到前面的。

senses.title: Settings stored by software
senses.definition: stored choices that tell a program how its user wants it to behave
senses.definitionCN: 程序记录下来的、说明用户希望它如何运作的选择
senses.example: The app keeps your preference even after you sign out.
senses.exampleCN: 即使退出登录，这款应用仍保留你的偏好设置。
senses.why: A machine that remembers a choice keeps a small record of what its user put first.
senses.whyCN: 会记住选择机器，就是留下用户「把什么放在前面」的小记录。

senses.title: A pattern in buying
senses.definition: the tendency of buyers to favour certain goods, brands or features
senses.definitionCN: 购买者更偏爱某些商品、品牌或特性的趋势
senses.example: Surveys track preference for local produce.
senses.exampleCN: 调查追踪消费者对本地农产品的偏好。
senses.why: Economists widen one person's taste into a measurable pattern of favouring.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家把一个人的口味扩展成可测量的偏爱模式。

senses.title: A taste shaped by culture
senses.definition: a leaning in style, art or custom that a group learns rather than inherits
senses.definitionCN: 群体习得而非天生继承的风格、艺术或习俗上的偏向
senses.example: Colour preference varies sharply between regions.
senses.exampleCN: 颜色偏好在不同地区差别很大。
senses.why: Shared leaning is still a carrying forward of one option, only now by a whole group.
senses.whyCN: 共享的偏向仍然是「把某一选项搬到前面」，只是搬运者换成了一个群体。

intro.en: Preference comes from Latin praeferre 'to carry in front, place before', built from prae- 'before' and ferre 'to carry'; English took it through French.
intro.cn: 本词来自拉丁语 praeferre「搬到前面、置于前面」，由表「在前」的前缀加 ferre「携带」构成；英语经法语借入。

items.en: Ferre meant 'to carry, bear, bring', one of the most common verbs of movement in Latin.
items.cn: ferre 意为「携带、承载、带来」，是拉丁语中最常见的移动动词之一。

items.en: Prae- meant 'before, in front', whether of place or of rank.
items.cn: 表「在前」的前缀意为在位置上或次序上靠前。

items.en: Praeferre joined the two: to carry something in front of something else, hence to set one above another.
items.cn: 两相结合构成的动词意为把某物搬到另一物之前，因此引申为把某物排到另一物之上。

items.en: French made a noun of the verb, and English borrowed it in the fourteenth century for the act of favouring.
items.cn: 法语把该动词名词化，英语在十四世纪借入，指偏爱的行为。

items.en: Courts and merchants narrowed the noun to a right of first payment and a lower tariff.
items.cn: 法庭与商人把该名词收窄为先受偿的权利与更低的关税。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the earliest English use is placed in the fourteenth century, and the older base behind ferre is generally considered a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：英语最早书证定于十四世纪，而 ferre 背后的更早词基一般认为是重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds words that look or sound close and are often confused with this noun; group two holds words for choosing and for liking.
note.cn: 第一组是与本词形近或音近、常被混淆的词；第二组是表示选择与喜爱的词。

entries.definition: The base verb meaning to like one thing better; the noun adds the result of that liking.
entries.definitionCN: 基干动词，意为更喜欢某物；名词则加出这种喜爱的结果。

entries.definition: The adjective built on this noun, describing treatment that gives someone first place.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词构成的形容词，描述给予某人优先地位的处理方式。

entries.definition: A noun for advancement in office, from the same verb but with a different sense.
entries.definitionCN: 同出该动词，但指职位上的升迁，义项不同。

entries.definition: An adjective saying one option is better; it evaluates rather than records a taste.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，表示某个选项更好；它作评价，而不记录口味。

entries.definition: The act of picking or the set of options; preference is the leaning that guides the pick.
entries.definitionCN: 挑选的动作或可选范围；本词是引导挑选的那种偏向。

entries.definition: Simple fondness for something, without the sense of ranking one above another.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的朴素喜爱，不含把某物排在另一物之上的意味。

entries.definition: The state of coming first because of urgency or importance, a matter of order rather than taste.
entries.definitionCN: 因紧急或重要而排在最前，讲的是次序而非口味。

entries.definition: A favourable condition or benefit; the trade sense of preference is one kind of advantage.
entries.definitionCN: 有利条件或好处；本词的贸易义是其中一种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Two real parts: a prefix meaning before, and a verb meaning to carry.
normal.cn: 两个真实成分：一个表「在前」的前缀，加一个表「携带」的动词。

normal.en: The family runs prefer, preference, preferable, preferably, preferential.
normal.cn: 同族词包括更喜欢、偏爱、更可取的、最好是、优先的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: have a preference for, give preference to, in preference to.
normal.cn: 固定说法：偏爱、优先考虑、优先于。

normal.en: Every technical use puts somebody at the front: a creditor, an exporter, a passenger, a setting.
normal.cn: 每个专业用法都把某一方放到前面：债权人、出口商、乘客、某项设置。

normal.en: The noun records a ranking; the verb records the act of ranking.
normal.cn: 名词记录的是排序结果，动词记录的是排序的动作。

abstract.en: Picture two identical cakes on a plate and a hand that always reaches left first.
abstract.cn: 想象盘里两块一模一样的点心，一只手每次都先伸向左边。

abstract.en: Picture a rope laid across a queue to mark who is let through first.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳子横在队伍中，标出谁先被放行。

abstract.en: Picture a screen that remembers which button you press every morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一块屏幕记住了你每天早上按的那个按钮。

examples.en: He has a strong preference for quiet rooms.
examples.cn: 他非常偏爱安静的房间。

examples.en: Preference was given to applicants from the region.
examples.cn: 优先考虑了来自本地区的申请人。

examples.en: You can change your preference at any time.
examples.cn: 你随时可以更改自己的偏好设置。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把「在前」与「携带」合起来看：把某样东西搬到前面，就是偏爱它、优先待它。

root: 拉丁 praeferre「搬到前面、置于前面」＝表「在前」的前缀＋ferre「携带」；英语经法语借入，由「置于前」引申为偏爱与优先；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one move: an object carried to the front is the one liked, served first, taxed less, paid first, chosen first, remembered by a machine, favoured by buyers and shaped by a culture.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：被搬到前面的东西，就是被偏爱的、先被服务的、少缴税的、先受偿的、首选中的、被机器记住的、被买家青睐的、被文化塑造的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two identical cakes on a plate, and a hand that always reaches for the left one first.
core.cn: 核心意象：盘里两块一模一样的点心，一只手每次都先伸向左边的。

branches.en: TASTE AND CULTURE: one person's liking and a region's shared style are the same favouring at two scales.
branches.cn: 口味与文化：一个人的喜爱与一个地区共享的风格，是同一种偏爱在两个尺度上。

branches.en: RANK AND TRADE: being served before others and paying less at the border both mean being moved ahead.
branches.cn: 次序与贸易：先被服务与在关境少缴税，都意味着被移到前面。

branches.en: THE LEGAL CLAIM: a creditor carried ahead of the rest keeps the image in strict order.
branches.cn: 法律的求偿：被搬到其余人之前的债权人，把这意象保持在严格次序里。

branches.en: THE FIRST CHOICE: what one would pick first stands at the head of a ranking.
branches.cn: 首选：最先会挑的那个，排在名单的最前。

branches.en: MACHINE AND MARKET: a stored setting and a buyer's pattern both record what is put first.
branches.cn: 机器与市场：存下的设置与买家的模式，都记录「什么被放在前面」。

intro.en: Preference is a Latin noun formed from a prefix, a carrying verb and a noun suffix; the same pieces build a small English family, so the word can be read in parts.
intro.cn: 本词是由表方向的前缀、表「携带」的动词与名词后缀构成的拉丁名词；同样的部件构成一个小英语词族，可按部分读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin prae- supplies 'before' and ferre supplies 'carry'; the noun suffix names the act, and English adds nothing further.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表「在前」的前缀提供「之前」之义，表「携带」的动词提供搬运义，名词后缀命名这一行为；英语不再加缀。

items.example: The verb is the carrying itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词就是「搬」这个动作本身。

items.meaning: to carry in front, to set above
items.example: To carry a thing in front is to give it the first place.
items.exampleCN: 把东西搬到前面，就是给它第一位。

items.example: The state noun named the favouring.
items.exampleCN: 这个状态名词命名偏爱。

items.meaning: a liking, or a right to come first
items.example: Her preference is for the coast road.
items.exampleCN: 她偏爱沿海那条路。

items.example: I prefer the earlier train.
items.exampleCN: 我宁愿坐早一班车。

items.example: The quieter route is preferable.
items.exampleCN: 较安静的路线更可取。

items.example: Bring a map, preferably a paper one.
items.exampleCN: 带张地图，最好是纸质的。

items.example: The firm won preferential terms.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司赢得了优待条件。

items.meaning: a share paid before ordinary shares
items.example: The fund holds preference shares.
items.exampleCN: 该基金持有优先股。

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉名词后缀而得同族动词，语义偏移为「更喜欢；宁愿」
由本词加表关系的形容词后缀构成，语义偏移为「优先的；优待的」
由同族形容词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「最好是」
由同族动词加表「可……的」后缀构成，语义偏移为「更可取的」
由本词加表股份的名词构成，语义偏移为「优先股」

definition_zh: 优先的；优待的；优惠的；偏袒的
definition_en: giving one person or group an advantage over others, or showing an unfairly favourable bias
core_image: 同一扇门旁另开了一条窄通道，只有持某种卡片的人能走，他在众人注视下先一步进了大厅
scene: 比赛开始前，看台最前排还空着几把椅子，穿制服的引导员把几位常来的客人从侧门领了进去。The club's preferential ticket window opened half an hour earlier.
sceneCN: 这里本词指给予特定人优待或优先的（第 1 个义项：让某一方比别人更早、更容易地得到好处）；句意为这家俱乐部的优先售票窗口早开半小时。

derivatives.zh: 去掉形容词后缀，回到同族名词，语义偏移为「偏爱；优先权」
由同族动词加表「更喜欢」的义项使用，语义偏移为「更喜欢；宁愿」
由同族形容词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「最好是」
由同族动词加表状态的名词后缀构成，语义偏移为「升迁；擢升」
由本词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「以优先或优待的方式」

senses.title: Giving one side first place
senses.definition: granting one person or group an advantage that others do not get
senses.definitionCN: 给予某人或某群体他人没有的好处
senses.example: The club's preferential ticket window opened half an hour earlier.
senses.exampleCN: 这家俱乐部的优先售票窗口早开半小时。
senses.why: The adjective is built on the noun for placing something in front, so it describes whoever gets that front place.
senses.whyCN: 该形容词建立在「把某物置于前」的名词之上，因此描述得到那个前位的一方。

senses.title: A lower tariff or rate
senses.definition: applying a reduced duty or interest rate to certain partners or borrowers
senses.definitionCN: 对某些伙伴或借款人适用较低的税负或利息
senses.example: Goods from the partner state enter under preferential rates.
senses.exampleCN: 来自伙伴国的货物按优惠税率入境。
senses.why: A reduced rate is the commercial form of being moved ahead: less is asked at the gate.
senses.whyCN: 降低的税率是「被移到前面」的商业形态：在关口被要得更少。

senses.title: Favouring unfairly
senses.definition: showing an advantage to one side in a way that others find unjust
senses.definitionCN: 以他人认为不公的方式偏向某一方
senses.example: The audit found preferential hiring in two departments.
senses.exampleCN: 审计发现两个部门在招聘上有偏袒。
senses.why: The same advantage, seen from the other queue, is no longer a kindness but an unfairness.
senses.whyCN: 同一份好处，从另一条队伍看过去，就不再是照顾，而是不公。

senses.title: Choosing the better candidate
senses.definition: selecting by a standard that ranks some options above others
senses.definitionCN: 按某套标准把某些选项排在其它选项之上的挑选方式
senses.example: The fund uses a preferential method to rank suppliers.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金用一套择优方法给供应商排序。
senses.why: Ranking is a neutral form of the same word: some option must stand in front.
senses.whyCN: 排序是同一个词的中性用法：总得有一个选项站在前面。

senses.title: A mating bias in biology
senses.definition: in animal behaviour, a tendency to choose mates with certain traits
senses.definitionCN: 动物行为中倾向选择具备某些特征的配偶
senses.example: The study recorded preferential mating for brighter plumage.
senses.exampleCN: 该研究记录了对羽色更艳者的择偶偏好。
senses.why: Biology applies the same advantage to mate choice, where one trait is placed ahead of others.
senses.whyCN: 生物学把同一份「好处」用于择偶，某种特征被排到其它特征之前。

senses.title: Priority inside insolvency
senses.definition: in law, the ranking that lets one claim be paid before others
senses.definitionCN: 法律上使某项债权先于其它债权受偿的位次
senses.example: Preferential claims are settled before ordinary debts.
senses.exampleCN: 优先债权先于普通债务获得清偿。
senses.why: Insolvency law turns the image into a numbered order of payment.
senses.whyCN: 破产法把这一意象变成编号明确的清偿次序。

senses.title: Ranking votes in order
senses.definition: describing a ballot on which voters number candidates by preference
senses.definitionCN: 指选民按偏好给候选人编号的投票方式
senses.example: Preferential voting lets a second choice decide a close seat.
senses.exampleCN: 优先投票制让第二选择决定一个接近的席位。
senses.why: The ballot asks the voter to arrange names in the order the voter would put them.
senses.whyCN: 这种选票要求选民按自己愿意排列的先后写出名字。

senses.title: Attention drawn to one cue
senses.definition: in psychology, attention that settles on one stimulus ahead of others
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中注意力先落在某一刺激之上的现象
senses.example: The experiment measured preferential attention to faces.
senses.exampleCN: 该实验测量了对人脸的偏好性注意。
senses.why: Attention that settles first is the mind carrying one cue to the front of the field.
senses.whyCN: 先落定的注意，就是心把某条线索搬到视野的最前面。

intro.en: Preferential is an adjective formed on preference, from Latin praeferre 'to carry in front', itself prae- 'before' plus ferre 'to carry'.
intro.cn: 本词是在「偏爱、优先」这一名词上加形容词后缀构成的，该名词出自拉丁语 praeferre「搬到前面」，即表「在前」的前缀加 ferre「携带」。

items.en: Ferre meant 'to carry, bear', the verb of moving something from one place to another.
items.cn: ferre 意为「携带、承载」，是把东西从一处搬到另一处的动词。

items.en: Prae- marked what stands before another thing, in space or in rank.
items.cn: 表「在前」的前缀标示在空间或次序上位于另一物之前。

items.en: Praeferre meant 'to carry in front', and so 'to set one thing above another'.
items.cn: 合成的动词意为「搬到前面」，因而也指把某物置于另一物之上。

items.en: French and English made first the noun for a favouring, then an adjective for the treatment that favours.
items.cn: 法语与英语先造出表偏爱的名词，再加后缀造出表这种处理方式的形容词。

items.en: Each field built its own fixed phrase: preferential claims, preferential tariffs, preferential voting.
items.cn: 各领域各自固定了说法：优先债权、优惠关税、优先投票。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the adjective's earliest English use is not firmly dated, and the older base behind ferre is generally considered a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：该形容词的英语最早书证年代尚无定论，而 ferre 背后的更早词基一般认为是重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds forms that look close to this adjective and are often mistaken for it; group two holds adjectives of advantage, fairness and priority.
note.cn: 第一组是与本形容词形近、常被误用的形式；第二组是表示优势、公平与优先的形容词。

entries.definition: The base verb meaning to like one thing better; the adjective adds the idea of granting rank.
entries.definitionCN: 基干动词，意为更喜欢某物；本词加出「给予优先地位」的意思。

entries.definition: The noun naming the liking or the right; the adjective describes whoever grants it.
entries.definitionCN: 命名偏爱或权利的名词；本词描述给予这权利的一方。

entries.definition: The adverb saying in what manner something is done, not what kind of treatment it is.
entries.definitionCN: 表方式的副词，说明以何种方式做，而非何种待遇。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning more worth choosing; it compares options rather than granting privilege.
entries.definitionCN: 意为更可取的形容词；比较的是选项，而非授予特权。

entries.definition: Describing conditions or terms that help; it need not imply that someone is ranked ahead.
entries.definitionCN: 形容有利的条件或条款；不一定意味着有人被排到前面。

entries.definition: Describing treatment that separates people to their disadvantage, the accusing use of this word.
entries.definitionCN: 形容以不利方式区分人的处理，是本词的指责性用法。

entries.definition: Reserved for a limited group; the advantage lies in shutting others out rather than in ranking them lower.
entries.definitionCN: 只为有限人群保留；好处在于把他人挡在外面，而非把他人排在后面。

entries.definition: Describing a person or group that already holds a benefit, rather than the rule that gives it.
entries.definitionCN: 形容已握有好处的人或群体，而非给予好处的规则。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the noun plus a relating suffix, so it describes whatever has to do with being put in front.
normal.cn: 该形容词由名词加表关系的后缀构成，因此描述一切与「被放到前面」有关的事。

normal.en: The family runs prefer, preference, preferential, preferably, preferment.
normal.cn: 同族词包括更喜欢、偏爱、优先的、最好是、升迁。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: preferential treatment, preferential tariff, preferential voting.
normal.cn: 固定说法：优待、优惠关税、优先投票。

normal.en: The same word serves kindness and accusation: a favour for one side is an injustice to the other.
normal.cn: 同一个词既能指照顾，也能指指责：给一方的好处，就是对另一方的不公。

normal.en: Every technical use names a ranking: of debts, of goods, of votes, of mates, of cues.
normal.cn: 每个专业用法都命名一种排序：债权、货物、选票、配偶、线索。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow side door beside a wide main door, opened for a card held by few.
abstract.cn: 想象宽大门旁还有一扇窄侧门，只为少数人手里的卡片打开。

abstract.en: Picture a rope laid across a hall so that one line moves and the other waits.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳子横在大厅里，一队人往前走，另一队人只能等着。

abstract.en: Picture a cursor that jumps to one corner of a screen before anything else is seen.
abstract.cn: 想象光标在别的东西被看见之前，就先跳到屏幕的一角。

examples.en: Employees were accused of receiving preferential treatment.
examples.cn: 有员工被指受到优待。

examples.en: The two countries signed a preferential trade agreement.
examples.cn: 两国签署了一项优惠贸易协定。

examples.en: Voters rank candidates under a preferential system.
examples.cn: 选民在优先投票制下给候选人排序。

dict_mnemonic.text: 名词「把某物放到前面」再加表关系的后缀：与「置于前」有关的，就是优先的、优待的。

root: 由「偏爱、优先」的名词加形容词后缀构成，该名词出自拉丁语 praeferre「搬到前面」＝表「在前」的前缀＋ferre「携带」；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one advantage: a front place in a queue, a lower rate at the border, a tilt that others call unfair, a ranked shortlist, a chosen mate, a ranked debt, a numbered ballot and a first-noticed cue.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一份优势展开：队伍里的前位、关境上的低税率、他人视为不公的偏向、排好序的名单、被选中的配偶、排定位次的债务、编了号的选票与最先被注意到的线索。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow side door beside a wide main door, opened only for a card held by few.
core.cn: 核心意象：宽大门旁的一扇窄侧门，只为少数人手里的卡片打开。

branches.en: THE GRANT AND ITS SHADOW: the advantage given to one side is the unfairness felt by the other.
branches.cn: 给予与阴影：给一方的好处，正是另一方感到的不公。

branches.en: CHEAPER AND BETTER: a lower rate and a ranked shortlist both place one option first.
branches.cn: 更便宜与更好：更低的费率与排好的名单，都把某个选项放在最前。

branches.en: BIOLOGY'S CHOICE: a mating bias applies the same advantage to inherited traits.
branches.cn: 生物的选择：择偶偏好把同一份优势加在天生的特征上。

branches.en: THE NUMBERED CLAIM: insolvency law fixes the front place as a position in a list.
branches.cn: 编号的求偿：破产法把前位固定成名单上的位次。

branches.en: BALLOT AND ATTENTION: a numbered vote and a first-noticed cue are both an order arranged in advance.
branches.cn: 选票与注意：编了号的选票与最先被注意的线索，都是预先排好的次序。

intro.en: Preferential is a derived adjective: a Latin noun for putting something in front, plus a suffix of relation, and the parts recur in a small English family.
intro.cn: 本词是派生形容词：拉丁语中表「把某物置于前」的名词，加表关系的后缀；这些部分在一个小英语词族中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin prae- supplies 'before' and ferre supplies 'carry'; the noun ending marks the state and the adjective ending marks relation, with no extra prefix in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表「在前」的前缀提供「之前」之义，表「携带」的动词提供搬运义；名词词尾标状态，形容词词尾标关系，英语未再加前缀。

items.example: The verb names the carrying of a load.
items.exampleCN: 该动词命名搬动一份重物的动作。

items.meaning: to carry in front, to set above
items.example: To set above is to carry in front.
items.exampleCN: 把某物置于其上，就是把它搬到前面。

items.example: The noun named the placing before.
items.exampleCN: 该名词命名置于前的状态。

items.meaning: a liking; a right to come first
items.example: The seat was kept by preference.
items.exampleCN: 这个座位是凭优先权留出的。

items.example: The rule is preferential to members.
items.exampleCN: 这条规则对会员有优待。

items.example: The funds were allocated preferentially.
items.exampleCN: 资金以优先方式分配。

items.example: Most guests prefer the early ferry.
items.exampleCN: 多数客人宁愿坐早班渡船。

items.example: His preferment came after ten years.
items.exampleCN: 他十年后得到升迁。

items.meaning: a reduced duty for chosen partners
items.example: The preferential tariff covers raw materials.
items.exampleCN: 优惠关税涵盖原材料。

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉形容词后缀构成同族名词，语义偏移为「偏爱；优先权」
与同族名词同源的动词，语义偏移为「更喜欢；宁愿」
由同族形容词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「最好是」
由同族动词加表状态的名词后缀构成，语义偏移为「升迁；擢升」
由本词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「以优先或优待的方式」
